reviews.title: Good Hotel but not worth the hype and money
reviews.text:
We spent three nights here (18th to 21st August) and had the following experience:

Positives:
- The location is great and a 2 min walk from the Gandola (cablecar). The hotel is nice and well maintained and views are beautiful.
- The L'Occitane spa was amazing.

Negatives:
- The hotel does NOT have AC and only has heating. Therefore, if you visit during any season besides Winter, the lack of AC is a problem. The room was hot and still!
- The swimming pool was very underwhelming and the water was torrid! 
- The jacuzzi in both the men and women spa bathrooms were half broken and not working.
- The food was average at best and extremely expensive for what they serve! Expected much better food and was disappointed. The Italian restaurant was still better but the main restaurant was sub-par.
- The housekeeping was not at all of a 5 Star Hotel - everyday they would mess up something or the other. 

Overall, the stay was decent but given how expensive the hotel is, we were fairly disappointed and do not think it was worth the hype! The hotel needs to improve and up their game!

reviews.title: Terrible - Avoid - Rude
reviews.text:
Terrible Experience at Khyber Himalayan Resort

Our stay at Khyber Himalayan Resort in Gulmarg on July 30-31, 2024, was nothing short of a disaster. The Chicken Biryani was excessively oily, overly spicy, and barely edible. The noodles were dry, lacking any vegetables, and equally disappointing. Despite our feedback, the manager dismissed our concerns with an indifferent attitude.

The issues didn’t end there. The resort’s indoor areas were unbearably hot due to the lack of air conditioning, and they refused to let us use the outdoor seating, which was covered despite the sunny weather. The staff's rudeness was palpable.

The situation worsened when my husband used the soaker tub in our room. The water was muddy and yellowish, and after draining, the room was flooded with dirty water. We were informed that the drainage was backing into the tub. Instead of taking responsibility, the staff and manager tried to cover up the issue. They offered us a neighbouring room, but with our original room filled with sewage water, that was the least they could do.

Although the Brava Restaurant provided improved service later in the evening, it felt like a superficial attempt to compensate for the day’s many failures. Overall, the experience was unacceptable, rude, and disappointing. I strongly advise against staying at this resort.

reviews.title: Luxury retreat at Khyber
reviews.text:
We stayed two nights at khyber. While you check in, you can sit at the Chaikash  lounge which has an amazing Himalayan view and you can see the mountains and the beautiful trees.

Rooms - we had premier balcony gulmarg view room, we really liked sitting in the balcony. The rooms are really luxurious and grand and the bathroom is huge

Amenities- The views from the heated swimming pool are amazing. They have water googles if you forget, It's open from 9 to 9 so there's enough time to go visit it. I also used the steam room, which was really nice. I didn't use sauna or the hot tub but they have both of these. The spa looked really good as well but I didn't have time to use it. 

The igloo room, has ping pong and caram and some video games. It's nice but they made it in the basement. For the property this size, It would be nice to have it somewhere upstairs with windows and view. 

Food - For food, there are two restaurants. There's an Italian restaurant where we did not eat and the main restaurant which has breakfast and dinner buffet. I think they serve lunch as well but we didn't do lunch. 
The spread just huge. Fresh fruits and everything you can think of like pancakes, waffles, dosas, uttapams, parathas, all sorts of Indian stuff. South Indian breakfast is just amazing. They make you delicious cappuccinos on demand. What stands out the most is the staff at the restaurant. Firdaus and Rayees really were the good care of us. The dinner buffet is also a huge spread. It's practically impossible to even try everything that they have on the spread. 
The only complaint I have with dinner is their desserts. They have a huge selection but nothing else appealing to me or my family. So I think they can up their dessert game a little bit. But overall, the food was delicious. 

From the hotel you can walk to the gondola. We enjoyed our stay at Khyber and highly recommend to anyone else who would like to stay there. 

The lobby is huge and there are so many different settings sections which where you can sit and enjoy. And there is a musician who plays Santur and he is amazing. The music is so calm and soothing as well as entertaining at the same time. We enjoyed listening to him.

reviews.author: Rakesh
reviews.title: Huge Resort, Beautiful Location
reviews.text:
The resort is located on a hill, a short hike up from the Gulmarg Cable Car 🚠 Station will take you to the resort. The location itself and view from the resort are superb, surrounded by tall trees and mountains all around.

Rooms and cottages are very spacious with all the necessary amenities. The double cottages are at one corner of the resort and it takes a long walk to reach the reception/restaurant area. Nevertheless, the rooms, interiors, lobby everything is neat and well-maintained. 

They do not have a bar, but Shrisha/Hookah is available. Food served in the restaurant was delicious. Both buffet and ala carte were equally good.

Overall a 10 on 10 package.

reviews.text:
I see'em glow🌸.

reviews.author: The Wanderer
reviews.title: 85 key resort is framed at every vantage point by nature at its most spectacular.
reviews.text:
A world away from the ordinary, this 85 key resort is framed at every vantage point by nature at its most spectacular. The world’s highest ski lift, the Gulmarg Gondola – which takes you to Kongdoori Mountain, is only a short walk away. Meadows and forests that have enchanted travellers for centuries wait to be explored by trekking enthusiasts and undying romantics. 
Clad in locally sourced pine and slate, the resort is built in a style true to the architectural heritage of Kashmir. In every way the indoors mirror the beauty of the outdoors. Speciality restaurants, a Sheesha lounge, a well-appointed spa and a heated swimming pool are amongst the necessary luxuries in place. Add to these other thoughtful additions like our children’s club, a mini theatre and a dedicated Activities Concierge and you will find The Khyber is a resort at par with the best in the world.

reviews.author: LifeandLeisure
reviews.title: A jewel of a hotel with one of the best spas in the country
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Khyber smack in the middle of winter (early March 2016) when Kashmir was snowed under. It was our first visit to Kashmir and we were so impressed with the hotel. What stays with us is the Kaava they served as a welcome drink (which we kept getting at their coffee shop because it was just so good) with lovely slivers of almonds and so, so flavourful. The food was wonderful, so was the atmosphere. Staff was very respectful and nice. Beware of touts hanging out outside the hotel who try to force you into a 'gondola' ride and ski trips. We had a reference from a friend who had recently been (Waseem, who acts as a local tour operator and ski guide - +91 8493961421 - safer to go with a known person who won't cheat you). Bought locally grown saffron, so fragrant. Loved this property and will surely visit for their luxurious L'Occitance Spa - one of the best spa treatments we've had in India yet and their heated indoor pool.

To counter altitude sickness, drink plenty of water and nibble on some chocolate: a tip we got from our ski guide in Switzerland and has helped me a lot (I very easily get altitude headaches).

reviews.author: ASarkar
reviews.title: Discourteous Staff!
reviews.text:
I went to Khyber for afternoon tea. My plan was to return and stay at the hotel with my family in Dec 2015, during snow season. The infrastructure and decor of this hotel deserves a 5 star! Everything looks splendid. However, like mentioned in many of the other reviews, the behaviour of the staff really falls short of expectations. There are no clear instructions written about which areas/lounges are only for residents and what are their opening-closing timings. So we went to lounges, without being stopped by anyone (security or staff), only to be told very rudely later that we weren't suppose to do so. I understand that all hotels have their own rules, but if they don't let the guests know, how are we to guess? 

I have stayed in many hotels across different countries in the last 20 years. However, I haven't seen such discourteous staff before. If it wasn't for my friend, I don't think I would have stayed for my cup of tea (Kashmir khawa priced at INR 300 a cup). In hindsight, I shouldn't have. We were served without a smile. We paid with our credit cards, and there too the cashier was impolite. The only friendly person was the doorman at the main entrance. 

I don't think I want to come back to stay in a hotel that charges like INR 20,000 for a night, and yet treats its guests like it's doing us a favour!

reviews.author: UshaShreyMurli
reviews.title: Am I In Kashmir?
reviews.text:
We drove from Srinagar to Gulmarg in an Innova driven by Pervez, a very helpful person. Nice road, drive can be accomplished in less than two hours. 
As per Pervez's recommendation, we stopped at a curve about 2 kms away from Gulmarg to pick up warm clothing which we would need when we reached the ski slopes. We also had deliciously soothing cups of Kahwa with low-sugar. 
Reached Khyber, which is in one word....Awesome!! The style and luxury it conveys is like an Alpine ski resort. The room we were in was large and spacious, for the three of us. The pasta that we ordered, fusilli with basil pesto and olives, in the restaurant was superb!! The breakfast spread in the morning was also very satisfying.
In Gulmarg, the highlight is the gondola-ride, which takes us to the top, and is done in 2-parts....both were working and we were told that if the weather is bad, the second one is shut. At the top there are no shops, places to relax and the air is thin. So please be prepared. My husband and son climbed the peak and managed to get a look at the LOC with Pakistan.
The other big deal in Gulmarg is the spa in Khyber. The family had the most satisfying, soothing massage ever, after such a long day!! Hats off to the Spa!
A good place to grab a quick freshly cooked vegetarian meal, is the Bakshi Dhaba, where we enjoyed a Kashmiri meal.

reviews.text: We had been to your valued  hotel  on 22nd n 23rd july 2015 and staying in room no 1010 during our Kashmir Holidays. There are local unions in Pahalgam but no such rudeness in allowing your car for reaching your Hotel or for parking even for 15 minutes. This is very ridiculous. Needs the management attention to promote tourism in kashmir & even your own image

My mom & me checked in The Khyber on the 25th of August 2014 around 12:00 pm & were very impressed with the surroundings & the hotel.  It is indeed a beautiful property with the loads of natural beauty all around it. As soon as we entered the hotel I knew I would love every minute of it. The welcome drink was the delicious Kashmiri Kahwah which really warms the body inside out.  It was very gracious of the hotel to upgrade us from a deluxe room to a luxury room. It really made our stay in Gulmarg much more memorable. The room was beautiful & had a touch of Kashmir. I loved the soap, shampoo & body lotion provided by the hotel. The hotel provides many services like free use of the gymnasium, Jacuzzi & steam. The WiFi is chargeable which disappointed me a bit because if the airport can provide us free WiFi then why not he five star hotels who charge a huge sum for the stay.
The restaurant is aptly located & has a beautiful view you can enjoy. It also has the facility of sitting outside. The À la carte menu had a variety of cuisines’. The buffet I thought was slightly expensive at Rs. 1680/- per head according to Gulmarg, it should have not been more than Rs. 1200/- per head.  I was a bit disappointed with the breakfast buffet as I thought it didn’t have much choice of continental dishes & it had more of junk food like doughnuts, pastries, chicken nuggets & potato wedges which I think are not appropriate for a good healthy hearty breakfast., although my mom overall enjoyed the breakfast. The fresh watermelon juice was delicious & the egg white omelet was very nice as well.
We especially want to thank Dr. Nazeer the hotel doctor who took special care of me when I wasn’t well & provided with complimentary medicines & also lent me pair of his gloves which was very thoughtful & kind. 
The hotel staff is very friendly particularly want to mention the hotel in charge Mr. Zaffar Malik who gave us personal attention & care. I will surely revisit The Khyber Himalayan Resort & Spa again & relive the beauty & hospitality of The Khyber Gulmarg.

reviews.author: RitasishB
reviews.title: Good stay, fantastic view of Gulmarg landscape from rooms
reviews.text:
Stayed there for 2 days in August with family. This hotel is located in a spectacular strategic location and undoubtedly has one of the best view of Gulmarg landscape from the room and the terrace. The staffs were nice and courteous. The rooms are very good with a combination of modern and traditional Kashmiri interior decor, spacious washrooms. Food was quite good and the breakfast buffet had good options to choose from. It has a temp controlled swimming pool (with Jacuzzi), recreational room for kids and adults. The Gondola station is very near to the hotel and max 5 mins walk (you can avoid the unnecessary bargaining with the ponnywallahs). 
Now coming to the let-downs..The check in process was not smooth at all. A non-smiling person was sitting in a small check-in counter and instead of greeting people was busy with his computer and doing all other things than giving me the room key. While checking out also, I was lucky enough to do it fast whereas I was witnessing people waiting for 30 mins as their luggage still didn't arrive. The surely need more people and expertise in that area. The person in the main coffee shop was rude and like me many guests were disappointed by his rude behavior. Another suggestion is the hotel should arrange for a complementary drive to the gondola station (which can be 2 mins max). I could see people was being fooled by the private car rentals and ponnywallahs just outside the hotel gate, who were charging 300-500 rupees for a one way ride.

reviews.author: Manshu
reviews.title: Just visited restaurant for snacks
reviews.text:
Fantastic property what great views - wish we had decided to stay here, the food was good, the service also great. 
Will recommend that even if not staying in Gulmarg - go there for a meal or a beverage and enjoy the view from outside the coffee shop

reviews.author: SCenturion
reviews.title: Almost Excellent
reviews.text:
This property has aged within a year to look and feel rather old and worn out.  I spoke to management and they advised they have been sold out since opening, and were unable to perform some maintenance rituals.  The will have to figure it out because the setting and the property are spectacular indeed.  

The staff is fantastic and the Kashmiri hospitality is genuine and unparalleled.  The high altitude made my parents a little sick, but the staff doctor arrived immediately and was very helpful.  He was kind enough to return the next day to check upon them, without us calling him.

There was chaos at check-in, they could use more staff there.  The main coffee shop could also use better management.

The L'occitane spa is excellent and I enjoyed a relaxing treatment here.  But why won't the hotel use L'occitane or other aromatherapy remedies for the entrance is beyond my comprehension.  The entrance to the hotel was constantly smelling of pest control and insecticides.  Please figure out a less toxic option for your hotel and for the guests.

reviews.author: Bindun
reviews.title: A place to explore beauty
reviews.text:
Best hotel in whole gulmarg, with temperature controlled room, ice outside your rooms was amazing experience in my life. It has very cooperative staff. bath area is very spacious.
In my room temp control was not  working they tried in all ways to make my stay comfort with providing extra heaters.

reviews.author: cpsahni
reviews.title: Khyber Gulmarg
reviews.text: Best and Beautiful property in Gulmarg.  It's value for money. Spacious modern rooms with Balconies overlooking the pine trees and snow clapped mountains. Food and Service was excellent. The Managers and General Manager we're always there at the lobby for any assistance.  We would love to come back to Khyber soon.

reviews.author: traveller-Mumbai-26
reviews.title: Heaven
reviews.text: I stayed with my family for first time in Khyber and truly appreciate the way this hotel is , Beautiful Decor, Excellent Rooms, Spacious Bathrooms but above all of this very very courteous staff and delicious food. What more can you ask for? No wonder it is one of small leading hotels they really deserve it. Kashmir is said to be Heaven on Earth and I would call Khyber Heaven in Gulmurg.

reviews.author: Sangeeta Bahuguna
reviews.title: Amazing Resort
reviews.text: Must say that this is one of the best resort in this region be it..location...comforts..hospitality ..n food.every thing is just amazing...credit goes to the GM Rajiv Prashar and the team for making this  a luxurious and wonderful home away for home amidest the scenic beauty. Would recommend it to my friends and family to choose this hotel for their next stay....

reviews.author: nms01
reviews.title: The Grand Khyber of Gulmarg!
reviews.text:
What a spectacular hotel to stay in finally in the prettiest part of Kashmir: Gulmarg! The whole hotel is wooden and right from the entrance one does feel the beautiful Kashmiri touch everywhere. The hotel is on a slight gradient and very close to the Gandola station.The rooms are done up very well and the wooden interiors of the hotel give it a lovely mountain feel... The deluxe balcony rooms are amazing with every possible conceivable modern comfort: Perfect bed, superb bathroom with a separate tub and shower area with 24hrs hot and cold water too, spacious balcony with comfortable reclining chairs and an in room coffee and tea maker. The room also had stunning views of the Gulmarg peaks. The heater was super effective but in the summers we needed to open the balcony door and sleep... which wasn't much of a problem infact we loved the fresh air! The Check in was smooth and the staff was very courteous and helpful! The room doors maybe need to be made sound proof as more than once we were awaken by noisy hotel guests talking loudly in the corridors while returning to their rooms. 
Had read a lot about the food served here and hence didn't know what to expect but was very impressed by the quality of the food the 2 days we stayed there. The indian fare was yummy as was the live pasta and chaat station that we had on 2 separate nights. The dinner buffet was wide and varied... right from a good Indian mix to Chinese too!The Caesars salad and the Waldorf salad was the best i have ever eaten in India! Kudos to the chef on that... the Indian breads were served fresh and crisp each meal and the desserts were simply superb! Special mention to the coconut cake, the almond and moong dal halwa and the pineapple fresh cake!! The breakfast was filling too with a wide array of eaties and 2 live counters for omelettes and dosas... The dosa chef made amazing hot uttapams and dosas.. thanks to his experience he did manage to satiate the food buds each morning deftly and swiftly! The cappuccinos at the restaurant were amazing! The service in the restaurant needs to be looked into as i felt that a lot of the staff there lacked experience in the field of hospitality... Yet understanding where we were, we did appreciate Mr Kamal for his absolutely impressive service each day and night, trying to tie up the loose ends. Thank you for your superb hospitality... Another special mention is BrijKishore, who each night with precision served us to the best of his ability!
The pool area was lovely... with enough deck chairs ready with towels and tall glass walls 2 sides. The pool itself was temperature regulated which was very comfortable. The staff was both helpful and knowledgeable there. 
All in all... a must stay when in Gulmarg! Such luxury in the heart of the Himalayas is a treat! We shall surely be back... this time during the winters for sure!!!

reviews.author: parag s
reviews.title: Good, luxurious stay!
reviews.text:
Stayed at the Khyber on 14th August with my wife. 

Beautifully done up hotel. It is just 2 years old but has already gathered enough kudos for itself including empanelment with the Small Luxury Hotels (slh.com).

On arrival, we were given a complementary kashmiri kehwa which was the best kehwa we had during the trip. 

The rooms were very well done up in standard 5-star way with a great view of the mountain peaks. The hotel has quite a few facilities for families - a heated swimming pool, a gymnasium and a kids play area called the igloo. No wonder that most of the other occupants of the hotel were families with kids. 

The hotel is very close (5 mins walking distance although it is a steep slope) to the gulmarg gondola starting point which is the chief tourist attraction in gulmarg. 

We felt that the food was extremely expensive. They have a buffet dinner priced at INR 1600 which we thought was a lot. 

Nonetheless, its a great property and ideal if one was looking to simply relax for a couple of days.

reviews.author: Global-Citizen
reviews.title: Excellent view and poor service
reviews.text:
This hotel has an ideal location facing the Aparwat peak , the rooms are large with balconies. It is a new hotel however the services are far from five star!
Housekeeping is poor, they forgot to put towels in the bathroom, the water was Luke warm and there were water patches leaking from the shower. The staff are very slow to respond. There is only one restaurant with average food and slow service. In short apart from the size of the rooms and the view this is by no means five star.

reviews.author: Nz K
reviews.title: The Best Stay in Kashmir
reviews.text:
If you planning a trip to Kashmir.... Definitely visit/stay at The Khyber in Gulmarg. It's the best that Kashmir has to offer in terms of comfort hospitality and food. 
For skiing addicts like me this is the place to stay during the season. A whole new experience and the owner Umar Tramboo is a fantastic host.

reviews.author: ZubairJalal
reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.text: This is coming from a SPG platinum member since 4 years now. I stay in hotels around 70 days in a year all across the globe and by far this is one of the best hotel that i have been to and that too in my home state. The management has put in a lot of effort to keep the local asethetics in place. Things like a 'vaguh' in the rooms, the chandeliers, the wall lights in the hallways - all of them have something that every Kashmiri can relate to. The service is good, the swimming pool is a good one and the location is breathtaking.  Its money well spent by the management. One advice - tie up with brands like SPG, Hilton etc. I am sure these brands would be more than happy to associate their names with The Khyber.

reviews.author: chander156
reviews.title: just superb
reviews.text: we group of 14 family friends stay here for two nights,this hotel is best in architecture and interior.good hospitality . very well equipped gym, health club and swimming pool. all the rooms have magnificent view of hills.one can say it is best luxury hotel of kashmir.hard to find any negative thing of this hotel.hotel lobby, hookah bar,garden every thing is perfect.

reviews.author: anishkila
reviews.title: The Crown of Gulmarg!
reviews.text:
If you've been to Gulmarg, you'd know there isnt much to do other than the Gondola ride, which I would suggest continue to Level 2, else dont do it. Also level 2 isnt what they advertise it to be, there is a patch of snow for your cool 'FB' pics, and a rocky trek of 20 min to satisfy that pseudo adventure holidaying spirit in you.

Coming back to the point, Khyber then to me is the next best thing, not just because no other property comes close to the grandeur but because it is such a vast upgrade over the rest that when you see the difference in the rack rates, you also know the reason why!

Beautifully built over the hill top, its got one hell of a steep entrance, so walking it is quite a pain, the ongoing dispute between the donkey guys and taxi guys means, you need to fork out a fat bunch everytime you wish not to slug it on your feet.

We personally didnt have the best of rooms and it took a while for them to figure out which ones were undergoing maintenance and which werent, but then there is no looking back ( other than the fact the neighbouring maintenance went on till 11 and was a little disturbing nonetheless).

I would always choose the valley view over the mountain view, cuz i dont care much for the barbed fences on the mountain side, the view however is still really beautiful on both sides.

For food, there are limited options, but quite good. The spa had tied up with L'occitane, so company loyalists would happily fork out the money.

The biggest blemish! they dont have a liquor license, so no drinks. Also few of the added features like quad-bikes, guided treks, private cinema etc are all unreasonably expensive.

Wouldnt dream of staying elsewhere if ever in Gulmarg again, although not much to revisit.

reviews.author: Neeraj Raheja
reviews.title: Excellent location and great service
reviews.text:
We were a large group of 12 adults and 7 kids and didn't want to compromise on our last destination in Kashmir and wanted it to be truly luxurious and I must say that The Khyber stood true to its reputation. The check-in was through a warm welcome by Mr.Zafar and complimentary Kawa for all of us which we all enjoyed. Can't complain that the check-in took a little while as we were a large group and a lot of us got busy checking out the beautiful hotel.

The rooms allotted to us we're all good and on the same floor. Must say that rooms with view opening to the swimming pool and the garden have better views than the rooms on the other side. Having said that the size of the rooms and the luxurious bathrooms and the balcony offer you just the relaxation that you are looking for.

The quality of food was excellent. Though a little on the expensive side we thoroughly enjoyed the buffet breakfast, ala-carte and buffet dinner. Yes it is true that the restaurant gets a little crowded during peak times but doesn't take like hours for one to find a seat.

Another point worth noting was that the hotel had an in house doctor to cater to any health needs of children with medicines being available in the hotel itself. It also has a large play area for kids called the Igloo which had a lot of games for the kids like air hockey, x-box, board games, blocks, etc

Overall a very enjoyable and memorable experience. Would love to go back in the future.

reviews.author: SyedAAbbas
reviews.title: Superb stay and hospitality
reviews.text:
I was at Khyber as part of a group. The hotel is amazing and the staff are very hospitable. After our journey, as we entered the hotel, I could feel the warmth of care by the staff towards us. Mr. Kamal Rawat is a fantastic person who made sure that we are well looked after and I would recommend him. Kashmir is a real paradise and Khyber resort lives up to it's name.

Thanks.

reviews.author: Suhail A
reviews.title: 5_star property with 2-3 star service and 7-Start charges
reviews.text:
I was very excited to stay at this Hotel as this was my first time at this hotel.
Hotel is in a very good location. The buildings and the rooms are very well done and nicely decorated.
However, everything good about this hotel , unfortunately stops there.
The hotel claims to be 5-star, however, the service and amenities are barely 3-star.
Right from the check-in, service is poor.
There is only one check-in desk which is not even properly marked. Guest are just standing around to check-in.
The staff at the check -in desk is not fully trained which makes check-in an arduous process.
There is only one resturant in the hotel which has to serve all the guests staying in the hotel. This makes for crowded tables and poor , slow service. The food choices are very limited.
The buffet is over priced with very poor voices. Plates and utensils are dirty and not up to par for a so called 5 Star hotel.
Room service leaves a lot to be desired. Out of 4 dishes that we ordered, 3 were made wrong despite us walking to the restart and talking to the person taking the order personally.
Prices for everything are exorbitant. Even to open the sofa bed in our room for our kids, we were charged 9000 rupees. I paid 9000 rupees to stay in JW Marriott in Delhi for a full room with excellent breakfast buffet and to and fro airport transfers. 
There were only two bath towels in the bathroom of the premium room for which the charge was 20,000 rupees per night. The staff was very reluctant to provide us with more towels. They wanted to charge us even for that.

Overall, I had a very bad experience at this hotel and will not ever again stay here. It saddens me that such a beautiful hotel is going to go waste because of poor management.
Being a Kashmiri, it saddens me more that we cannot provide service to our visitors that would be at par with any 5 tar hotel in the country.
I would request the management and the owners to visit JW Marriot in Aerocity, New Delhi, to see what good customer service means and how guests are treated in a dignified manner.

reviews.author: Prasad Shriyan
reviews.title: Excellent location, good property. Poor service though!!
reviews.text:
The location is just amazing.. Everything else you would want to do in Gulmarg is about a stone's throw away.. The view from the property is amazing and its well maintained.. 
The service at each touch point was a sore experience for me.. be it check in experience, food quality, speed of service, restaurant timings, housekeeping, etc. were all let downs... Rooms do not have cooling so those visiting in summer months beware... This hotel doesn't have a bar.. So for the dough that you would shell out for room reservations & other services at the property, the value is what you will miss...

reviews.author: RahulRampuria1977
reviews.title: Khyber - Not an enjoyable hotel
reviews.text:
I am currently staying at the hotel, and saddened with my stay, I am prompted to write a review on this property. 

There is an absolute lack of attention to service in the hotel, particularly in restaurant.

The buffet served here is average and I was surprised to find the same food being served in the afternoon and evening buffets. 

The lobbies stink and the wooden panelling around the staircase and corridors look worn down and archaic even though the hotel is barely 2  years old. 

The small coffee shop in the hotel closes at 8 pm, leaving no option for guests to sit down, relax and have something to drink at night.

I was also told by localites that the hotels flushes all it's waste into the river, which finds it's way through the villages. This has caused health problems among localities, I was informed. If this is true then the management should take a serious view on this matter.

Overall I would rate this hotel to be of 4 star grade with little attention to service and would request the management to improve the quality of service.

reviews.author: RajaKalra
reviews.title: Too notch Service and Rooms!!!
reviews.text:
As soon as we arrived at the main door the view and hotel were good,but as we entered the hotel and saw there hospitality right from the relaxed check in process with endless cup of their traditional KAWA to showing us the entire property which is huge!!! It was top notch.
Mr. Zafar really deserves a very special thanks from our side as he made our honeymoon trip so memorable that we remember him till now whenever we remember about the trip to Khyber he was very generous to arrange a room decoration and a cake which we cut outside with the snowfall and he was with us courteous enough to capture that moment. From the time we entered I just loved this hotel and the staff was very courteous and hospitable.I really enjoyed my stay!!! As I am hotelier my self. I will visit this hotel again.

reviews.author: sunilkatariya
reviews.title: Khyber
reviews.text: The property was good and the service was ok. Given the price, they charge, I would rate them who just meets the expectations. However quality and variety in breakfast was not so great and also found the buffet dinner priced on the higher side.

reviews.author: Goabizzle
reviews.title: Nice 5 star property
reviews.text: We visited in July 2014 with 2 rooms for the family.  We were greeted by a very friendly lady staff at the reception.  We really liked the rooms, it was clean and had a perfect view of the place.  I would definitely recommend this property.  The buffet however is catered mainly to vegetarians and with only 1 chicken and 1 fish dish for the non vegetarians so please check this before you book.

reviews.author: Anks124
reviews.title: Surreal property with exceptional service!
reviews.text:
One of the most beautiful properties I have ever been to! Highly recommended... If you are in Gulmarg, this is the place where you ought to stay.. expensive, but fully worth it.. Now the details..
Loved its:
1. Location- High up on the hill with astounding view of the valley. You cannot take your eyes off the view.. (Please take a room with the mountain valley view)
2. Service- Staff is extremely helpful and caring. This was my first vacation with my 5 month old son and the staff took extra care arranging a baby cot, warm water, mashed apple, whatever I asked for.. they even gave us a complimentary cake when I told them that this is Ahaan's first vacation. They gave us good advice about where to go, when, etc.
3. Pool, jacuzzi, sauna and steam- Their pool is oh so awesome. On the hill, it is an indoor heated pool but two walls are made of glass reaching up to almost 20 feet of ceiling giving amazing views of mountains and trees while swimming. The free jacuzzi, steam and sauna refreshes your body and mind!

Additionally, the interior of the hotel was very traditional and Kashmiri but still quite modern and tastefully done. The food was also good in Cloves restaurant and not over-priced. (Advice: Please go for Ala-carte. Buffet is expensive) 

What could be improved:
1. The property is on a high hill and the walk down till the valley where the Gulmarg gandola is there is quite steep. Downhill is still ok but Uphill.. phew!! The hotel could arrange for some golf carts or something for the guests.. But I think this is more of a Gulmarg problem since the local people with horses do not let any taxi or even hotel cars operate in the area since it cuts into their business.
2. Another restaurant serving some other cuisine could be added.

Please definitely stay at this property.

reviews.author: AmanDayal
reviews.title: Good Property, Poor Managment
reviews.text:
The property is nice but suffers in service and extremely poor management. The staff and management lack the drive to make your stay comfortable. For the room tariff, the experience is a couple of notches lower. The stay is as good as a budget hotel, but for the location and infrastructure. The property has central heating only in rooms and becomes stuffy and suffocating to dwell in the summer months.

The reception staff is no better than of a travel lodge and the senior management is pretty impotent in getting anything done or at the least have decency to respond to a resident guest for any discomfort. Any requests/complaints go down a rabbit hole.

The Restaurant staff is amateur too. They are disorganized and all over the place. The buffet will cost a good $25-$30 (Rs. 1600) but the food selection is worth $2 (Rs. 100-120). If only anyone cared to review any suggestions/feedback.

The Chaikaksh (Coffee shop) is a decent place to hang around for a cup of tea/coffee and enjoy the Himalayan view. The server/manager there may be the cordial staff at the Khyber Gulmarg property.

This property enjoys the monopoly advantage in Gulmarg, since there are no other hotels in vicinity that offer so many amenities. But it is a real disappointment if you are looking for luxury and fun. The staff and service is just too unpleasant an experience. A real let down by the renowned Khyber Group.

Go stay there since you don't really have a choice of place in Gulmarg but the experience is no better than that of a clean Budget Hotel.

reviews.author: RahulC
reviews.title: Good property but Improvements needed!
reviews.text:
We were a group of 13 adults and 3 children. We stayed at this property for 2 nights (Check in 15th Aug and Check out 17th Aug). I searched for the best tariff for this hotel on online travel websites and my regular travel agent in Mumbai. But I got the best deal from Sawhney Tours and Travels, Srinagar.

We had booked 6 premier mountain view rooms for Rs 12,500 per room per night which included tax and breakfast. Out of the 6 rooms, 3 of our rooms were upgraded to Luxury Balcony rooms.

Before our stay, I did write to Mr Alex (G.M.) about looking forward to a great stay. He was prompt in his reply and assured us of a good stay. Even Mr Arun (Director of food and beverages) got in touch with me to enquire if we had any special dietary requirements. A good start!!
 
Our stay at this hotel could clearly be divided into two different experiences. To begin with we arrived at the hotel at 4.30pm.We were allotted 3 luxury balcony rooms (east wing) on the first floor and 3 premier mountain rooms on the minus one level (This was after requesting for all 6 rooms on the lobby level as we had senior citizens and children in our group and the hotel lift is still not operational). The premier mountain view rooms are around 386 sq. feet. The rooms were very modern, well maintained with flat screen television and tea/coffee warm kettle, centrally air conditioned, etc. Similarly the bathroom was fantastic with a nice shower section and a bath tub. But on close inspection the bath tub had brown dirt stains which was a downer. The phone and television was not working!!! I had to personally walk to the reception to inform about the problems and they said they would have it rectified. The view from the mountain view rooms was an absolute disappointment. On opening the curtains all we could see is trees and the parking complex!!! In the defense of the hotel management we faced cloudy and rainy weather during our stay in Gulmarg which had curtailed the views to an extent.

By dinner time, nobody had yet come to rectify the above issues. I,my wife and my 6 month old daughter went for dinner and this time we were clear about our disappointment. Fortunately, we ran into Mr Arun and Mr Deepak who understood our concerns and promptly changed our room to a luxury balcony room (east wing) on the lobby level. From then on, our stay only got better.

The luxury balcony rooms (568 sq. feet) are absolute luxury. Huge rooms and bathrooms with a wonderful balcony overlooking the valley. If there are no budget constraints I would definitely advice people to take balcony rooms but in the south wing. The east wing rooms have a good view but the view from the south wing is definitely better.

I happened to meet Mr Alex the next day. He explained that since the last 3 days it was raining heavily in Gulmarg hence they were facing issues with their telephone and televisions. He acknowledged the problem of the bath tub which he said was a problem in their system which he was going to completely overhaul! 

The breakfast spread in the hotel was great. South India, Pav Bhaji, cereals, milk shakes, juices, sausages, baked beans, cappuchino, kahva etc... Our first night dinner at Cloves restaurant was average. They have a buffet (Rs 1600 p.h.) but we opted for ala carte. Most of the dishes are priced in the range of Rs 600-700 plus tax. Our next days dinner at Nouf (open only for Dinner) was great. Its an open air grill restaurant and definitely pricier (Rs 800-Rs 1000 per dish plus tax) but the food was fantastic. At Nouf we can bring our own alcohol and they are happy to serve it to us. This restaurant has limited capacity and tends to go full. Hence prior reservations recommended.

Vodafone postpaid subscribers will not get network in the hotel except in the balcony of the luxury balcony rooms. There is full network when u exit the hotel. The hotel also has a cigar and sheesha lounge. The hotel does laundry for children clothes at 50 % of the normal laundry tariff. 

Gulmarg does not have wine shops. No hotel in Gulmarg serves alcohol.

The spa and swimming pool are not operational. They have a private theatre which unfortunately was booked during our stay. They have a small children's activity play area.

Mr Alex and his team have a great property. I am sure they will iron out the glitches faced by us. I would recommend a stay at this property when all their facilities are operational (January 2014 onwards).

reviews.author: JI009
reviews.title: Heaven on Earth !!!
reviews.text:
We stayed in Khyber for just 1 night ..wish we could have stayed longer. It is probably the best property in Kashmir. Awesome location, fantastic hospitality and service. The views from the hotel were just unbelievable. Rooms were very tastefully done, food was great and staff was very helpful. 
In all an awesome experience, if one goes to Gulmarg should definitely plan to stay in Khyber. Want to do it again in Winters !!!!

reviews.author: SuruchiAKT
reviews.title: A lil piece of heaven
reviews.text:
I am one of those few lucky people to have stayed here in the starting few months of its opening. Though august is off season, the weather is still great and the charm still intact.

As soon as one enters the doors they are welcomed by the cozy interiors filled with kashmiri potraits, brick bracks , rugs and a chaos of furniture which still is in sync with the environment. The welcome drink, a kashmiri tea known as "kawah" is a delight served along with cookies. 

The staff is surprisingly all male (atleast I personally didn't see any female staff, which is a pity and should be changed). However every member of the staff is fluent in english and high in etiquettes. 

The rooms are comfortable and clean. I had the opportunity to stay in one of the deluxe rooms which have an attached balcony and a tub. It was bliss to soak in the hot tub with a view of himalayas just in front of me. I had requested for scented candles in order to have an extraordinary experience, the candles were given but weren't scented or of high quality, but that wasn't going to dampen my spirits. It would be great though of the hotel can make arrangements soon to include paraphernalia for guests to have an in-room spa experience. 

Speaking of spa, the manager of the hotel had brought to our notice that the spa isn't operational yet but would be soon enough. The hotel has tied up with L'Occitane en Provence for the spa. All I can think of is making a trip again to avail the spa facilities soon.

The food was good. Not too great not too bad. They have excellent variety, but sometimes the preparation lacks balance of flavours. I believe that in some time that would be rectified. They have many restaurants including a cigar and hookah bar which wasn't operating yet but should be something interesting.

All in all the place is a little piece of heaven on earth.We can enjoy luxury in the lap of nature. I definitely would visit again in winter.

reviews.author: anshu1212
reviews.title: Truely a PARADISE on earth !!
reviews.text: It was our 2 nights stay there..& the most memorable one..If you want yourself to get pampered amidst the nature,please visit this resort..The staff here are so well groomed & make you feel really special..We totally fell in love with this place from the moment we stepped in..i would recommend that its a must stay resort if you are in Kashmir..They have great facilities,but only if you want to booze then you can get your own stuff to the hotel..We are looking forward for another visit soon :) :)

reviews.author: RCR1000

reviews.author: Rahil R
reviews.title: Great property, but a work in progress
reviews.text:
Khyber seems to sit atop the rest of Gulmarg and commands beautiful views. The hotel is contemporary but with definite Kashmiri touches that help the hotel stand out from the rest of the luxury resorts that you might have stayed at. But the hotel is definitely a work in progress - the spa is not compete (odd since they have the word Spa in their name) and they haven't really worked out all their operational kinks yet. For example, they offer a helpful car pickup and drop off service to the town and back, but the number they gave me to call for the car pickup was either incorrect or no one picked up my call. Luckily I had the number of the driver who had dropped me the previous day and I was able to get a car to come pick me up, but had to wait in the rain for 10 mins. On our 2nd day there they didn't have a lunch buffet because there were too few guests (made me feel like I should have checked out with the other departing guests) and when I enquired about dining options at the time of check-in they forgot to mention that Nouf needed prior reservations. These all are fairly trivial in the big scheme of things, but they do add up especially when you're expecting luxury. 

The rooms though were beautiful and given how close the hotel is to the gondola's I think it would be a great place to stay for skiers. 

All in all, I'd probably stay here again because I think by the time of my next visit they would have worked out all these details.  

PS: The beds and pillows were terrible. They were so soft that I kept sinking in and the pillows barely gave my head any support. I actually napped on the couch in the room.

is really close to the Gondola's.

reviews.title: Ode of purity

Just waiting for the pool and spa to be operational. Planning another trip after 6 months.

reviews.title: Superb Experience in the hotel which is only few months old

reviews.author: Akshat G
reviews.title: Great stay- heated pool was the highlight
reviews.text:
We had a good stay at The Khyber, Gulmarg, with several aspects that truly stood out, though we did feel a bit more could have been offered considering the premium price point.

The views from the room were absolutely stunning, overlooking the Himalayan mountain range - easily one of the highlights of our stay. The heated pool was excellent and very welcome in Gulmarg’s cold weather. Food and service at the food table were prompt, well-managed, and consistently very good.

That said, for a hotel of this category, we would have expected a few more comforts such as heated water in the flush and being provided with two key cards by default, which would have made the stay more convenient. At the same time, we do understand that maintaining a large luxury property in a remote, high-altitude town like Gulmarg comes with its own operational challenges, and we do acknowledge the effort that goes into keeping the hotel running smoothly in such conditions.

Special mentions go to Firdous at Cloves for attentive service, Wasim Yusuf, whose Rubab playing added a beautiful and calming cultural touch to the experience, and Owais at the spa/pool, who was very helpful and courteous.

Overall, a pleasant stay with memorable views, great food, and standout staff but with room for improvement to fully match its luxury positioning.

Give at least 2 key cards
Washroom seat should be heated or the water there should be heated.

reviews.author: VishalDugar
reviews.title: Khyber You Gave Kashmir A Bad Name.     WISH THERE WAS AN OPTION TO GIVE A MINUS RATING.
reviews.text:
I would like to narrate the Horrifying Travel Experience i had with The Khyber (Gulmarg) with the timeline, so that all of you who are Reading the said review are able to Take an informed Decision on spending a lot of your hard earned money for which the arrogance of the Khyber Management  has no Value.  

Its me today who went through this Insinuation But It Could be You Tomorrow. 

Every Luxury  Property has to understand the importance of being Super Diligent and Not Negligent, its in the Hospitality, Service orientation is and should be the untold law and most basic factor expected  unlike treating their Paying Patrons as Guinea Pigs, and to make you understand that such Negligence is the last thing that was expected which resulted in the catastrophe for me, a ruined vacation on a special occasion, a permanent loss of business for the Property, due to such Bad vibes that i would probably never visit or if consulted would never recommend any informed Traveller   to visit the Khyber Ever  

The reason for the late review though my travel dates were 28th September 2025 to 1st October 2025 is that i was immediately taken unwell in Gulmarg after check in itself, the reason  was due to the extremely potent varnish used on the wood all through the property,  and it got lot worse later and i was  diagnosed for sever Macula Edema in the eye all due to the Chemical varnish that was applied to wood all through the property, the same led me to administer Heavy Oral Steroids along with an injection of steroid called Ozurdex in the eye and i sill haven’t completely recovered yet.  And the shame is that when i brought it to the  Management's notice, they accepted and said that it was a planned renovation, and  though i made the booking directly with the Property i was never informed about the same.  Its a mandate that if there is any planned renovation happening in the property all who are making a booking are duly informed and if the said renovation bothers the guest he or she can back out if its an inconvenience to them.   Which was not the case here at all.    

Time Line:

The One experience that had been on my bucket list as an Avid traveller who has experienced almost every Continent was  to visit (The Khyber at Gulmarg)since the day it came to existence, the lure of the location, the property, the  thought of Kashmiri Hospitality was much higher then visiting any European destination even and in a way WAS proud to think so. 

Our whole Visit was completely Khyber Centric and neither we had any plans nor did we venture out to any other place it was Airport to Khyber and Vice Versa, unfortunately my excitement was short lived.  

First the Positives:

Location:		Gulmarg and Khyber are Un Separable and no visitor ever visiting Gulmarg would not want to glimpse the Khyber if He or She isnt  staying there would and infact  Wish to be staying sometime in their lifespan as a Bucket list, such is the Aura of the property which offers Style, Brio, its Monolithic and Magnificent at the same time like no other property in Kashmir, wins your heart immediately.   Surrounded by the  The Imposing mountains of the Pir Panjal Range in the Himalayas, and nestled right in between  coniferous fir-laden forests, the Magical  property looks right out of a fairy tail book, much like a quaint Austrian or Swiss village Abit even better.  

Property: As mentioned place looks like a Fantasy, everything is superbly well laid out from the temperature controlled Swimming Pool, the well spread and amazingly well curated gardens, thoughtfully placed swings (facing the forests), seating areas, everything is perfect if the intent is to relax, detox and destress.

The Human Factor:	A little bit of a mixed bag but the people who were good need to be appreciated for the salvage they could try to do with the Broken Trip and the unwanted mess created during the stay:

Mr. Mohammed Rafi (who acted diligently and was humble all through my stay)
Mr. Owais (front desk, who tried to be as calm and welcoming he could be)
Mr. Arif (who on noticing the fiasco that happened the first night at dinner tried to make sure the breakfast was spot on, and its the only meal we had at the property, only breakfast for 2 nights)
Mr. Abdul (Our Driver for pick up and drop was actually the person who needs to be most appraised and appreciated  if i didn’t go by the hierarchy) he was a true saviour during the trip, mild mannered gentlemen to the core, who made sure that we could understand Kashmir through a very different lens, from a locals perspective)  

Everthing was down hill apart from the postives that i have mentioned above:

1.	Reservations:  I was coordinating with Mr. Goofran who asured me that sir the occupancy on the days of your  travel are really low and that if i booked the mid category room directly with the Hotel, the next  higher balcony category would be made available and that i cannot document this on email as others are in cc but rest be assured it will be done, i went on his word and transferred the said advance as asked by him directly to the Hotel and not through any online portal (who were offering a substantial discount of @ 7000 further more to what i paid the hotel directly, but i still chose to make the reservation directly with the property).  A few  days post making the reservations i called the property again and asked if i could make the balance payments at the hotel, Goofran  rudely told me No and instead asked me Why hasn’t the balance payments been made by yourself”, i reminded him that it was his duty to tell me when the balance payments need to be made and that too by text or call and not just email as emails tend to go to junk box, which was the case with me.  Post making the payments i called the hotel a couple of times to speak to him i was only told that he has gone to the property and that he would call me back, but the truth was he had left the organization, the whole experience was very bizarre. 

2.	  No Point of time was i told there is NO AIR CONDITIONING by anyone including their  website, Khyber may be a ski resort (which i presume is but you have a good 6 months of warm weather and being on a higher altitude as cool as it gets in winters the sun rays come as hard and temperature of 24 degrees could easily feel like 30 plus  degrees (and im sure you guys dont shut down during summers right ??).  Which is what we experienced while check in, when our room was allocated, its only while in the Room Owais told us Sir there is no air conditioning and also the windows don’t open. We were getting baked in the room at @ 4.00 pm when we checked in.

3.	Brazen and Arrogant Attitude in The Human Factor:  Apart from the people i mentioned and appreciated above, people seemed cold and disinterested even, which in-fact should be Opposite to Kashmir as the hospitality here is legendary, this became most evident when alteast 4 different staff members whom i was interacted with, told me something that was shocking and each tried to be very obvious when they said “Sir what we are charging you for your stay is actually our per night rate” HOW DARE anyone say this to a Paying Guest?Patron, thats the most embarrassing thing i have heard in my years of travel experience India and Abroad and its Insinuating , i would rank this as the worst thing ever told to any guest and Kyber  should be embarrassed to the core, any business is about Demand and Supply and the economics of the price are based on that.   Its you who is offering the said price right and you are advertising the same with the intent to have guest back (and Rs 69000 for 3 nights is still not cheap), Today when a guest comes to Kashmir there is a sense of risk He or She associates and when they brave it given the innumerable options available in India even for hills (from Himachal Pradesh to Uttrakhand to the Beauty of North East) its the travelers way of saying to every one is Kashmir “We are with you as one and here to explain to the world that its Safe and the valley of Beauty, Wisdom is Open for all to experience with NO FEAR ….

4.	Something as simple as a Tax Invoice had to be followed for,  Its supposed to be a default thing right ? Its only when i wrote the email i was given the same (that too after more then a month) 

5.	Food is an Absolute Disaster barring Breakfast and more so if you are a Vegetarian:   The one paid meal we had was dinner on 28th September 2025 post which me and my wife  didn’t have a single meal in the Hotel cause of the bad  experience, cause the food was such a disaster, we were super exited for-the meal the first night presuming that atleast  the food wouldn’t go wrong in Kyber, we being vegetarians went on the staff recommendation and ordered Kashmiri Dum Aloo as a vegetable what was served was like piece of stone with gravy, Arif who was around understood the same and immediately acted and said sir leave it and he did take good care of us during breakfast the next 2 days. But just imagine this that a in-house guest did not have a single meal cause of the bad experience, the food was still billed to me and i still paid it.   

6.	NO Proper Information:  since check in no one would administer any information about what the property has to offer unless asked, this is a Resort and a Spa right ??  isn’t it as basic that when a guest is staying for 3 nights be informed about the property and more so when the guest has expressed a desire to host 20 couples later in the year and that this trip was more like a Recee (the same was mentioned in the email to the property and Goofran before i arrived), wouldn’t that be incentive enough for future business. I eventually landed up signing up another Luxury property in Himachal Pradesh the said Gm of the property  not only hosted me for 2 nights but also was Courteous enough to help me understand in person how the event could be held along with with Options such as a Picnic, Hike, special meals in different venues  and How the guests could be made to feel Special, thats what true Hospitality and leadership is all bout, understanding and valuing the Business of a guest.  Khyber has miles to go in that regards.  You could still proclaim to be the best but in my eyes and with my experience it would be sheer Arrogance.   Cause Khyber doest care and thats arrogance

6.	Treating your Paying Customers LIke Guinea Pigs:   If you have your property under renovation of any sort  its a mandate and your duty to inform the guest and more so if you are using any kind of a potent chemical like a varnish which can create major Pulmonary issues for your guests, i dont even know if thats legally permitted to so when you have resident guests, i had immediately documented the same the very next morning  as i had taken ill, and it got a lot worse to a point its only almost after a month that im recovering, and shuffling from mumbai to Chennai (multiple visits)  to see my Dr and get my self treated.

I Had  never asked for any Refund (which given my situation was my right to do so) and more so it would have been dignified from the properties end to do so, but instead i  am offered to come back to the same  place (at my cost of Airlines,cab etc) all at a special rate to a self proclaimed  “heaven on earth”

reviews.author: PrithviRaj
reviews.title: Vinit (GM),  Bilal (F&B Head) and The entire Khyber team were brilliant
reviews.text:
We visited The Khyber Gulmarg last evening for dinner at their Italian restaurant and had a truly wonderful experience—made exceptional by the hospitality of the team.

A special mention to Bilal, the F&B Head, who ensured that our experience was incredibly warm and welcoming from the moment we arrived. He was impeccably well-groomed, gracious, and genuinely kind—especially noteworthy since we were not staying at the hotel and had simply walked in for dinner. His hospitality reflected true class and set the tone for the evening.

We were also warmly greeted by Vinit Chhabra, the General Manager of The Khyber, who was the first to welcome us upon arrival. His humility, kindness, and personal attention were immediately evident. He ensured that all our needs were taken care of and made it clear that his team was completely at our disposal. It’s easy to see that The Khyber is run with remarkable efficiency under his leadership, and we are certainly looking forward to staying at the property with him on our next visit.

Junaid and Muneena were equally supportive and attentive, helping ensure everything ran smoothly and that we felt comfortable throughout our visit.

At the restaurant, Varun, the restaurant manager, along with Saba, were extremely adaptable and helpful. They took the time to understand our preferences, made excellent recommendations, and elevated the dining experience with their thoughtful approach.

And finally, Arif, who served us—consistently attentive and caring. He made sure we were always well-hydrated, well-fed, and looked after without ever being intrusive.

Overall, the experience was a perfect example of refined hospitality—warm, respectful, and effortless. Even as non-hotel guests, we were treated with the utmost care and professionalism.
Highly recommended for both the food and the people behind it.

reviews.title: Winter family vacation
reviews.text: The thing which impressed us was the lavish interiors. But the resort lacks in terms of some amenities which should be a necessity for a top notch property. As the ambient temperature gets extremely cold in the winter time, there’s no hot water facility in the bidet which is really inconvenient & m really surprised that the celebrities staying in the resort aren’t highlighting this. Also the areas outside the rooms aren’t air proof leading to cold air entering everywhere. The resort food quality is good but very costly ( which has become very common in all five star properties in Kashmir valley for whatever reasons). Mr. Waseem of housekeeping is the brightest star as he is attending to each & everyone’s needs & ensuring that the resort’s high standards are maintained. The heated swimming pool is a good one but there should be a life guard available & there should be time allotted to families & couples as the couples get really cosy in the pool which sometimes becomes inconvenient for the families.

reviews.author: Chandrika Das
reviews.title: Must visit.
reviews.text:
We booked our stay at the Khyber Himalayan Resort in the last week of December 2021 (27th-30th). Before coming we were a bit sceptical given the remote location of the resort , but we were in for a wonderful suprise seeing the efficacy and passion with which this resort is run. 

The rooms were well appointed and luxurious. The bathrooms were spacious. The housekeeping staff Mr. Gulzar and Mr. Nisaar  always kept our room immaculately clean. They were always just a call away to look after our needs and ensured we had a comfortable stay. (Room Nos. 1009&1011) 

We took all our meals at Clove, where the menu is elaborate and the food excellent! We would always look forward to having a hearty breakfast which was quite expansive. 

We were looked after by Mr. Firdous - who was so warm and welcoming. Firdous ji looked after us with great zeal and affection, making sure we were always well fed and his care and concern was more of the kind one reserves for one's family. We ordered à la carte meals, but Firdous ji would always so generously heap our plates with choicest of desserts, sabzis and whatnot, which were a part of their dinner buffet. He would always give fabulous suggestions with respect to what to order and all his suggestions worked very well for us. He would always try and remember what each one of us liked and made sure that we had something special at every meal. 

I cannot wait to be back here on this property which has the warmest staff who has their attention to every little detail. The minute you enter the property you are engulfed with a certain warmth - which I feel is quintessentially Khyber. 

As I leave today, I know I will miss this place intensely, but I rest easy knowing I have a bit of paradise tucked in my heart forever. 

Thanks once again Firdous ji, Nisaar ji and Gulzar ji. You've created magic which no one can surpass.

reviews.author: Himanshu Das
reviews.title: Beautiful Views, Warm Hospitality.
reviews.text:
Khyber Gulmarg is one of those hotels that one must experience at least once in their lifetime.

The hotel does a fantastic job in every aspect - right from the property upkeep to the room comfort, ambience to views from the room, restaurants to housekeeping Khyber can give even the best hotels of the world a run for their money. 

I would like to thank a few people for making our stay comfortable - Mr Waseem at the front desk for the warm welcome, Mr Gulzar Bhat and Mr Nisar from the housekeeping team for taking care of our smallest of requirements and last but not the least Mr Firdous Parray at the restaurant Cloves who truly exemplifies world class hospitality and efficient service. Thank you once again. 

Overall I will definitely recommend Khyber if you’re planning to come to Gulmarg. Remember you’ll need to make reservations good 6 months in advance as this place is always full.

reviews.author: Gaurav Aggarwal
reviews.title: Luxury with Snow
reviews.text:
The place is rightly overrated and is a must visit for every couple once in there lifetime. 

Hotel is beautifully built with trees, mountains and snow as it’s background. A beautiful property with amazing staff gives you the best taste of hospitality in the lap of luxury. 

Really enjoyed my one night stay at the hotel with picturesque views all around, food and sheesha. 
They don’t have a bar and allow to bring your own booz which is fantastic actually seeing the high prices of everything. 

The food is delicious along with great service. The rooms are comfortable with correct amount of heating making the stay easy during extreme cold weather days and nights. 

The prices are very high but the experience is worth it. Honestly one night is enough to soak in the views and experience the hospitality.

reviews.author: Nj
reviews.title: Overrated hotel with rude staff
reviews.text:
We were very excited to stay at the overhyped  The Khyber.
But we were very disappointed with the very basic and unmaintained rooms and the rude staff. The housekeeping staff entered in our room even after we directed them to do up our room after we come back from breakfast. But to our surprise we found 4 technicians along with 1 staff member in our room installing a new telivision and they made us wait outside for 15 mins. When we called the manager to complain rather than apologising he said they have the authority to enter the room sometimes without any prior notice to the guest and they can come in at emergencies ONLY. But is replacing a Television an emergency?? After calling several times all that the GM did was say that he will look into the matter.We are actually questioning are selves if it was worth waiting for the stay in this property where everyone is so disrespectful towards their guests? Is it worth staying in a place where you are spending an exorbitant amount and there is no respect to guest privacy?? Very disappointing stay and not recommended at all.

reviews.author: Aditya Mehta
reviews.title: Gulmarg- a place to visit for the snow & view
reviews.text:
Pros:

Right from the airport the pick up was very smoothly done by Asif- representative from Khyber at the airport & he helped with the departure to Bombay as well. 

The driver Akram & tour guide Bilal also were really warm,friendly and ensured we had a good time sightseeing or with the gandola activities etc.

We were lucky to probably get the last room available at the hotel. We stayed in a single room cottage and room was very spacious with balcony on both ground and first floor. Except we were 3 people so had to put an additional bed for one of us.

The view from the room balcony and from different parts of the hotel was great and that’s the biggest USP of the hotel I would say. 

Staff was very prompt and they were just a phone call away. Be it room service or housekeeping etc.

Cons:

As for the food,the local kashmiri food was good and rest was pretty average I would say. The hotel was at full capacity but the food could’ve been much better. 

Price wise as well all food was above 1000 Rs which even for 5 star standards is on the expensive side.Also a lot of the food was fried & given which is not something we liked and had to ask them to make the dish again.

Also since except Skiing & all snow activities there was not much to do,we enquired about the cinema they had. The cost was Rs 15,000 + GST regardless of no of people if its 2 or 15 people. We found this very expensive and not even worth considering.

reviews.text:

The property is par excellence.. It's totally worth it to pay extra to get the Himalayan view room. The majesty of the Himalayas literally seeps into the room. Luxury at its finest.

I really don't want to be in Kashmir and eat idli for breakfast and hakka noodles for lunch ( though I get it that a lot if people appreciate their own comfort food.)
This is where the awesome staff comes! A  resort is truly made by their staff and nowhere us this more true than the Khyber.
Just mentioning that I really missed having Kashmiri food had Sameer getting the head chef and both of them promising Kashmiri food for all our meals. Bilal who just heard me mentioning that I was craving for Girdha ( a local flatbread) and had it buttered and steaming hot for me at the breakfast table .. and last but not the least , Firdous..at the restaurant, who took such good care of us, that literally..by the time we thought of it, it was in front of us. Kashmiriyat at its best. 
Not to forget Nazir at the resort entrance who ensured that all our excursions were the best.
It was all these people that made The Khyber , the experience that it was.
Apart from the fact that the weather Gods looked kindly upon us and we had awesome weather all throughout the trip.
The Khyber Himalayan Resort and Spa is a fablous property that I would highly recommend .
Please do note that some facilities are not available due to Covid restrictions.

We didn't want to leave....and we definitely will be back 💖

reviews.author: Ektaa S
reviews.title: Winter Wonderland!
reviews.text:
We went for a family vacation amidst the pandemic. It was a much needed break. The location of the hotel is fabulous! Completely surrounded by mountains and long pine trees covered in snow! What more can you ask for? Once the climb to Gulmarg starts, the drive to the property is scenic. It was snowing when we arrived giving us the perfect opportunity to experience snowfall.

The hospitality of the staff is amazing. They are warm, kind and extremely helpful. They took care of all our needs and cravings. From stuffed kulchas and gulab jamun to Quesadillas and French toast everything was super!! On days when we were tired of eating indian food, the chef as well the manager Mr. Shyam took special interest in providing us food of our choice.

The staff was always present for all our needs. Special thanks to Aijaz, Ishfaq, Iqbal, Firdous and Tawheed for taking care of us! (Photo of them attached).

Sadly we missed out on the heated pool and spa which was shut due to the covid pandemic. Definitely coming back when it's completely functional! 

It was an amazing experience! Can't wait to visit again ! Kudos to the Khyber team!

Drawbacks:
The property is situated on a hilltop. Even though it's very close to the gondola, the walk is very steep and can be slippery in the snow (only issue during snowfall). They do not provide any transport to and fro to the gondola where all the other activities are also present. You are left at the mercy of cab/ATV drivers. 
PS: carry proper snow footwear for the walk.

reviews.author: prachi2017
reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.text:

Rooms are cozy and warm, great food options, Sheeha(hukka), no bar but you can carry your own and they allow to drink in the dedicated cafe.
Hotel as a heated pool, this was one of the Best exp. to be in the pool and see snow covered mountains!

reviews.author: Aryamihir

reviews.author: Travel The World With AJ
reviews.title: Beauty covered in snow
reviews.text: We loved the stay at this hotel. It was a luxury resort, a short walk from the gondola ride. The food was sumptuous with lot of local cuisine choices. We loved the kahwa (local tea) during our stay at the resort. The closed warm water pool with unobstructed view if the snow clad hills was one of the key highlights of this hotel.

reviews.author: Mani D
reviews.title: Out of this world
reviews.text: We stayed at the Khyber to celebrate our parent’s birthday, and the staff went out of their way to make it a memorable one. They decorated the room, arranged for a cake and constantly ensured we were comfortable througout our stay. To experience the true authentic beauty of this part of the world, I wouldn’t recommend staying anywhere else. The views are breathtaking and the location perfect.

reviews.author: Parinitha S
reviews.title: Truly a Five Star Experience
reviews.text:
My husband and I stayed at Khyber for two nights from 22nd to 24th Dec. From the minute we entered till we checked out, everything was as perfect as it could be. The decor and architecture of the hotel truly depict Kashmir's heritage. The views are to kill for, food is delectable, and the heated pool is all you could ask for in the chilly winters.
The staff is courteous and super helpful. All you need to do is ask and it shall be taken care of.
Also, the Gulmarg Gondola is only a 5-minute walk from the hotel.
We will certainly return for a longer stay here.

reviews.author: Shara Naroosh
reviews.title: Holidaying in Gulmarg, Kashmir
reviews.text: Recently myself and my husband went holidaying in Gulmarg. Following my friend's advice, we decided to stay in Khyber Himalayan Resort and Spa and it was a marvelous experience. The hotel premises provided a great view of the mountains and the resort was more like a palace. The staff were extremely friendly and helpful. Our check-in and check-out processes were smooth, thanks to the staff. Food was also great! We loved the ambience. It's only a walking distance to the Gondola ride. We were there in December and  hence, the snow covered mountains and roads were beautiful sight... The hotel is expensive, however, it's worth the money. The rooms are nice and cozy. If you are traveling to Gulmarg, I wouldn't have a better place to suggest for a stay. Even if you would not like to stay, I would recommend this place for a fancy lunch or dinner where you can enjoy the astounding view whilst enjoying your meal...

reviews.author: Eka L
reviews.title: My family has never been happier
reviews.text: Khyber is not only a resort, it’s an over all experience. We stayed there for three nights to celebrate my parents anniversary, each day was better than the previous. The hospitality, the restaurants, Gym, pool and spa.. all were of the best possible standards. The seesha’s were amazing. Food was so yummy that we overate eatery meal! What was even better for us, was that when we came, it was green, when we slept, it had snowed a little, when we woke up, the whole place was white! Getting to see that transition was amazing. The heated pool, while it snowed outside, the amazing jacuzzi and the steam, sauna room were also really good in standards. My special mention to the staff, specially Sameer, they make up feel so belonged that they won part of me permanently. Can’t wait for my next stay!

reviews.author: Rahuls82
reviews.title: Luxury in himalayas !!
reviews.text: Stayed in Khyber in Dec 2018 with my wife and 5 year old son. Property is state of art architecture with spectacular views. Rooms are nice but wifi internet wasnt working smoothly. Even though I complained twice the issue wasnt resolved although technicians visited my room twice.  Some people might find food expensive but its amazing. reviews.author: FarzanaKhanSA
reviews.title: Kashmir 2018
reviews.text:
Awesome hotel with first class service. Upon arrival we were welcomed by Mudasir, the attendant at reception. He gave us a tour of the property and seated us down to a hot cup of Kessar Kahwar (Saffron Kashmiri tea), while the staff took our luggage to the room. Breakfast was an absolute treat with Bilal and his team meticulously attending to our every need.

reviews.author: Rupali Chachad
reviews.title: Feel the magic of winter in Kashmir amid warmth of hospitality. Thanks Team Roamland Holidays
reviews.text:

The trip overall was memorable & everyone served us so nicely. We want to convey a word of thanks via TripAdvisor to all especially Khyber Resort who are magical in  hospitality. Highly recommended to visit Kashmir & Khyber Resort as well!
