reviews.author: Atiroh S
reviews.title: Fantastic views around the hotel!
reviews.text: My family of 5 stayed there for a night after a full day of activities in Gulmarg. It was a perfect end to our visit to Gulmarg. Hotel staff were polite,and provided excellent service! You are expected to tip them for their service.

reviews.author: Akal1980
reviews.title: Location location location (and the POOL)
reviews.text:
What a perfect location. Breathtaking views no matter which window you look out of.  

The Good
- Location: Stunning views and amazing proximity from the Gondola and ATVs. Perfectly located
- Heated pool: Definitely the highlight of Khyber. Perfect temperature indoors with the snow clad Himalayas and beautiful tall pines  
- Spa: A must do, hard to explain the experience, just go for it
- In-Room dining: the food we ordered in-room (italian, Indian and snacks) were excellent.
- Room: bedroom and bathroom are an ideal size. The bed is huge and comfortable.
- Clean: very well maintained hotel. great housekeeping  
- Service: courteous, helpful and flexible staff like it should be in a 5 star. We lost one of our jackets at the airport. It was tracked, the hotel taxi arranged for it to be collected and delivered to our room (at no charge). During the dinner buffet, we wanted a white sauce pasta for our 3 year old, that wasn't on the menu, but they made it and didn't charge extra. We asked for a tour of the hotel, and they spent a good hour showing us every nook and cranny. 

Could Improve
- Buffet: While the breakfast and dinner buffets are good, they could be better. Eg. in breakfast, would be good to have more options of cold cuts, assortment of cheese, granola / cereals and non-veg.
- Food prices: Be ready to go light on your wallets
- Response time: We made a couple of requests where it look a bit longer that we expected for the staff to arrive - like a personal tour of the property (which was amazing, must do), and luggage collection at check out (its like they didn't want us to leave ;) ).  
- Cupboard: is a little tiny. Make use of the drawers in the room
- Bathroom hanging: between the towels, robes and wet swimsuits, you'll have insufficient hooks for hanging 
- Kids entertainment: while every kids channel is available, the play area could do with a few more options to keep kids engaged for longer.
- Internet: speed is a bit slow, mobile 4G (at least Airtel) is way faster. Will get better results using your hot-spot. 

Travel tips
- Get a guide: Go to the Gondola with a guide especially if you have a child. He will help manoeuver and carry the kid at slippery places. Its a big help.
- Negotiate: Even if its 'fixed price' for activities like skiing, snow-biking etc. Your guide will help you pull down the price by 50%
- Sledge: not worth it, stick to skiing. snow biking and the 13KM ATV ride
- Boots and coat: rent a set for your trip up the gondola ride. If its snowing, make sure you have them for your ATV ride as well. Whenever you stop and jump into the snow, you'll need them.

reviews.author: rajivpmehta
reviews.title: Winter wonderland
reviews.text: The Khyber is well situated within Gulmarg and is staffed with the warmest people I have experienced at a hotel. The comfort of their guests is of paramount importance and they deliver with full marks. There is only 1 Multi cuisine restaurant but the food is very very well prepared with wide ranging options. Definitely a big recommend!!

reviews.author: Amruta M
reviews.title: Stuff dreams are made of!
reviews.text:
Without a doubt the best property in and around Gulmarg! We visited The Khyber for two nights in mid december for our Anniversary and were lucky to have witnessed snowfall throughout our stay which made our stay even more special. The temperature control swimming pool is the usp of the hotel and the view from the pool is straight out of a fairytale. The hospitality is impressive and the staff leaves no opportunity to make their guests feel special. Special thanks to Ms. Khalida & Mr. Vinit Kumar Chhabra for taking efforts to make our special day a memorable one!
We are surely coming back for a perfect experience :)

reviews.author: RaviArora
reviews.title: A Vacation Unmatched!
reviews.text:
Traveled with my family, wife and 2 grown up kids. Was difficult to convince them to travel to Gulmarg during the winters, especially when you know it is freezing cold, with temperature going upto -14 degrees!

But once the uphill climb started from Tangmarg, the excitement made everyone forget about the temperature.

The Hotel - Khyber was located, amongst the Pine and Deodhar Trees, away from the place where quite a few Hotels are located, yet very close to the Gondola (Cable Car)

We upgraded to the Himalayan View Rooms as the vast view of the Green Trees and the Mighty Himalayas was breathtaking. We had the Balconies to each of the Rooms, well heated inside, and with everything we would have wanted.

So much so, that you would not miss the view even while in the Bathroom, as the Bathrooms had huge windows, allowing the same view as that from the Balcony! The Shower was fantastic, wonderfully hot and fantastic force, unlike the ones where you need to bucket up because of poor pressure!

The property is very well maintained and the staff is very courteous, polite and greeting you every time you come across them!

The Steam, Sauna and the Jacuzzi was excellent, and we could not help but using them repeatedly. And then the Heated Swimming Pool! Initially, we were a little worried about the temperature but then once we dived in, we did not want to be out! 

Swimming in water temperature at 30 degrees with Minus 12 outside! Snow covered Himalayas with the Green trees now turned White - result of the continuous snowfall!

The Food was equally good and with a nice spread! Though quite expensive, but then they do have a reason charging you for such fine dining at that heavenly location!

Would surely like to visit again, and would look forward to the Management offering us with Loyalty Upgrades and Benefits! :D

Ms Khalida at the Reception during the Check-out was concerned to know about our stay, and had that confident look, knowing that the feedback shall be worthwhile! 

The only minus point was  - Our Stay was for only 2 Nights! You need at-least 4 or 5 Nights, to enjoy this beautiful place and the Hotel! The view changes every hour and is worth every penny spent!

reviews.author: Urja K
reviews.title: What an incredible experience
reviews.text:
The pictures don't do justice. This hotel is marvel. What made our experience even better was actually the F&B manager, the Spa front desk, the doctor on call. A special thanks to each of them. The First&B manager went out of his way to ensure the stay and meals were very comfortable. I had a severe tooth ache and in the middle of the night the doctor on call literally made it within 20 minutes to give me the right treatment and injection. The pain that I felt this was inparallled and all thanks to the doctor the trip was such a fantastic experience the next few days. The rooms, view, hospitality and gulmarg itself is brilliant. 

For honeymoons, family trips I think anyone in India who hasn't been there yet is a fool for missing out on this treasure. 

We plan to go there this year too in February and hopefully every year after. 

Take a bow, team Khyber. You make us proud.

reviews.author: RanjeetNabha
reviews.title: An amazing time!
reviews.text: My daughter and I stayed at the Khyber this December.  It was snowing and my daughter got to play in the snow and build a snow man on the Khyber lawns.  This hotel is top notch in all areas - location (overlooking Himalayas), room (super comfortable and warm), food (wide variety and delicious) and service (amazing staff that take a genuine interest in your well being). We are already making plans to return next year!

reviews.author: Abhay Goel
reviews.title: Simply the best in Gulmarg
reviews.text:
I'm writing this review from the hotel room. Experience starts as soon as you enter the property. Lobby has typical Kashmiri seating areas which add to the beautiful ambience of the hotel. Rooms are spacious and tastefully done. Room had a big balcony with seating and beautiful view of the mountains. Rooms have automatic temperature control and maintain a comfortable warmth even when the outside temperature is 10 below freezing. 
Bathroom is big with a recessed bathtub and a separate bathing area.
There's lot of space outside the building for kids to play in the snow. My six year old kept herself busy making a snowman. The property has one of the best spas and an indoor heated pool.
Staff is very  friendly and courteous.

reviews.author: Praneet
reviews.title: Not worth the price, not value for money
reviews.text:
Sure the property is beautiful, no doubt about that. We paid roughly INR 16000 per night for the premium deluxe room (lowest category) inclusive wifi, breakfast and taxes. We stayed at Khyber for 2 nights. In terms of the way it is made, the property is really good.

The view from the hotel from every angle is great. The cafe is a good place to hangout as they serve shisha (starting INR 600) and allow you to sit with your own bottle. The spa here costs about INR 3900+taxes which will go upto almost 5000 per person. Dinner buffet prices are INR 2500+taxes. The breakfast spread was good. We only ordered an appetizer once. Dishes generally cost INR 700-1000 per item + taxes.

What we did not like were 2 things, 1. the negligent service towards guests and 2. the differentiation between the room categories.

The heated indoor pool with the amazing view was not actually heated to the right temperature. We complained both the days at the pool reception and at the main reception. There were other guests also who we spoke to, who had the same issue. Both days, we changed, got in and immediately got out feeling cold. The water was not cold, but it was not even warm. It was just moderate and the outside temperature was rather cold so overall, it was not comfortable being there. It was supposed to be a heated pool. The person came and manually checked the temperature to be 29 degrees, but it was really not even lukewarm, honestly. Hence, this for us was a complete waste, both the days. It was practically the only amenity which we could have enjoyed free of cost.

Ours was a premium deluxe room. The other 2 upper category rooms are the Luxury Gulmarg view and Luxury Himalayan view. Both these upper categories have balconies. The differentiation we did not like was the interiors in the premium room, where we stayed. It was very blah and not really made up to the mark. It does not give you a feel of any luxury at all having spent INR 16000 per night on it. It's a very basic room which otherwise in 5 star hotels would cost around INR 6000-8000, very ordinary interiors. What we very much disliked was that, these premium rooms are in a separate wing which is not centrally heated. Both the upper category rooms are in the same wing (away from the premium rooms) and that wing is completely centrally heated. We complained about this as well to the front desk, but they did nothing for it, at least in our 2 day period.

Overall, we had a very dissatisfying experience at Khyber and understood and realised well that only if you opt for the higher category luxury rooms, will you really enjoy the property and feel worth for the money you paid. Cannot comment on the massages as we did not take them. Swimming pool for us was a disappointment with the temperature not being actually 'heated'.

reviews.text:
Awesome secluded place.. amazing view. lovely time with snow.. away from Gulmarg city. miss having any skiing facilities. this gives amazing memories.. soon will plan again. 
a tad expensive but worth it..

Perfect mix of Kashmiri tradition and modern lifestyle. Scenery outside is icing on the cake!! Keep up the great work!!! (View from gym in pic)

reviews.author: SriramJSS

Staff was very courteous, friendly and helpful. We have taken himalayan view room and view(s) from the room are mesmerizing. You can spend days looking at the hills and doing nothing else. Staff was very helpful. Food was very tasty and the menu is very elaborate given the remote location they are in. Property is very beautiful and aesthetically built. Overall, we had a fantastic stay here.

reviews.author: Neha R
reviews.title: Heaven!!!
reviews.text: I had booked Khyber for my anniversary.  As I reach Khyber and am in awe of the place, I get to know Agoda has messed up my booking. I was really upset trying to connect with Agoda, but painfully, I could not get through them initially. The manager and the staff at Khyber is so amazing, i am short of words. So, I had booked the Himalayan view room, but agoda has messed up and sent the details as Gulmarg view to the hotel, the manager here agreed to provide me the himalayan view at 50% less of the difference amount. As we checked in and stayed at the hotel, the manager ensured we are not charged for Agoda's mistake. The staff was so courteous and at your service all the time. The place is so tastefully done and the location is to die for.

reviews.author: ApurvNagpal
reviews.title: Great property - needs better service, lower pricing
reviews.text: The property is beautiful, truly amazingly constructed, with lots of wood, natural elements feel. There is a golf course nearby, as well as the cable car - all walking distance. They have a lovely indoor pool, which thanks to its glass walls, has a very open feel. The staff is friendly. However - I found the rates quite exorbitant, especially given the occupancy which was close to nil when I was there. Also, quite surprisingly, I was given a room with a view of the parking lot. When questioned why it wasn't a better view, was told it's what I had booked and would have to pay extra for a better view. This is when the hotel is empty. BTW - the hotel also doesnt serve alcohol (which I think should be mentioned clearly on the site) but apparently doesnt mind if you get your own.

reviews.author: jangsiewfong
reviews.title: A FABULOUS HOTEL
reviews.text:
The hotel is luxurious, beautifully designed with superb facilities and lovely snowy view of the mountains. Rooms were spacious, clean and comfortable. The restaurant has a wide selection of choices range from international to local dishes. All the service staff always had smile on their face, courteous and helpful.  
The hotel provides jeep service to carry guest and luggage from the foothill to hotel door step.  We were cheated by our tour guide asking us to pay in rupee to the local service to carry our luggage and guest by sledge to the hotel.  We would like to thank you the hotel management and staff who took quick action to help us on this.
We highly recommend this hotel and would love to stay here again.

reviews.author: Esh G

reviews.text:

From the restaurant to the room balcony your views are like a postcard; picture perfect.

reviews.author: Ananthi S
reviews.title: Mrs Ananthi Sharma
reviews.text: Excellent Resort with most amazing customer service. Every staff are always at their best courteous attitude. Especially Ashfaq from guest services and Aijaz from the restaurant. Thank you for making our stay comfortable. Will definitely be back again soon!

reviews.title: Overrated
reviews.text:

reviews.author: MOTIAHUJA
reviews.title: An Oasis in Paradise
reviews.text:
Our Stay At Khyber, in December 2015.
The Place, The Property & The People are Par Excellence. 
Suggest they do away dishes with Lamb (if cannot improve), mark over spicy food & check electrical s (specially hanging lights in front of blowers as they swing and make night a nightmare) before every Check In.

reviews.author: PiyushJalandhara
reviews.title: Himalayan Retreat
reviews.text: This is best of all Kashmir in terms of hospitality and location. I am glad to have chosen to stay with Khyber on my first ever visit to Kashmir. I have been travelling for 10 years now covering various location, this one I would rate as my best stay ever and I am sure this would  be remain number 1 in my list. They are unmatched in terms of hospitality and quality across Kashmir. To view sunrise or sunset go to terrace Nouf and enjoy the peace and tranquility of sunrising/ sunsetting  over Himalayas. Pool / Jacuzzi was under maintenance, however visit to pool area is must to catcht the glimpse of himalayan reflection in the indoor pool. Right from reservation desk to Hotel manager to the chef ensured that every bit of our stay was enjoyable and making it more memorable. Breakfast buffet is scrumptious and grand. Special thanks to Mr. Aabid and Mr. Basharat. I am sure to visit again.

reviews.author: Rohit G
reviews.title: Expensive but worth trying
reviews.text:
Location - fantastic, luxury balcony room with himalyan view.we stayed at room 2015.
Food- average to good. Very expensive
Comfort - excellent
Facilities- although swimming pool was closed for renovation but i am sure once resumed overall the facilities would rate 5 star.
Room' very good, spacious.
Hospitality- excellent at its best.

Overall a great property to stay but at a high cost.
Lots of staff member to br thanked for their hospitality -Mr Ashar ( duty manager) Mr Irfan to name few. These were the names i could recall but trust the entire staff was extremly courteous.

reviews.author: Anamika_Butalia
reviews.title: Great hotel, horrible service!
reviews.text:
For my birthday recently, I decided to do a winter holiday in Kashmir with a group of eight comprising family and friends. In Gulmarg, we stayed at The Khyber and were mesmerised by the property—its location, views, property as well as rooms. We stayed for two nights. 

Although we had a really pleasant stay, since the rooms are very comfortable and spacious, the food is good, there were a LOT of negatives!! 

On check-in, the front office desk didn't even take us through the hotel's offerings—the various restaurants, the spa, the pool, etc. In fact, when I enquired about the pool, they mentioned that it was closed due to maintenance and would inform me when it opens up. I didn't hear back from them at all. On my last day, I decided to walk around the property before checkout and much to my dismay found that the pool had been fully-operational during the period of our stay.

The next evening, we ordered some room service and no one showed up with our order. No one even called to express regret at missing the order. It's like they'd forgotten or that we were unheard.

Neither did the housekeeping staff give us proper instructions on using the heating system. So, every few hours, we had to call and ask for someone to come and fix the heating, change temperature, etc. 

When you go to a place like this, you expect exemplary service. Unfortunately, The Khyber fails in this very category. During checkout, the front office desk didn't even ask whether we had a pleasant stay!! For the hospitality industry, this is an offending low! I had to ask to fill up a feedback form to put down our grievances.

reviews.author: Namy10
reviews.title: Best place in Gulmarg...
reviews.text:
We booked 2 rooms in Khyber. We stayed in the month of November.
 
It's a human marvel & architecture at a place at this altitude. The lobby is grand . You are welcomed warmly and the check in procedure is completed at Chaikash with "Kahwa"  as Welcome Drink.
 
We were escorted to the room and explained all the functionality. The rooms are good carpeted and excellent view from the room.

The hotel is just a few minutes walk from the gondola station.

The hotel is beautifully maintained throughout. They have a play are called Igloo which is much needed as there is not much to do after sunset.

The only downside to this magnificent hotel is the F & B services. We were booked on a breakfast and dinner plan. All the days we were there the buffet was a complete letdown. The buffet spread was minimalistic. This was brought to the notice of the duty manager. He tried making up by offering a complimentary starter.

All in all a great place to be when in Gulmarg

reviews.author: Sopy80
reviews.title: Fairy Tail Rooms and Hotel
reviews.text:
The only Four star hotel in the vicinity , a wooden hotel with real Kashmir art and architecture.The grand entrance and the big chandler above the entrance gives the feeling of grand welcome and richness of the culture.
The lobby is well furnished and decorated with authenticated kashmirii karigiri including the seating arrangement and their choice of covers which represents nice nakashi. The staff bestows all the goodness of the Kashmiri hospitality and culture and same applies to the food which has its own taste and a treat to test buds.
The Rooms are grand and best with their available resources , one must see the Gym area which has huge glass with the view of deonar trees and falling snow..  
Over all its a treat to eyes and mouth .. go ahead and enjoy it

reviews.author: Priyank K
reviews.title: Amazing Place
reviews.text: Best resort in Gulmarg. The locations and the scenic views are just perfect. Although the food prices are a little steep but the surroundings more than make up for it. Highly recomment to stay and have fun.

reviews.author: Traveller7019
reviews.title: Breathtaking, ideal place to stay in Gulmarg
reviews.text:
The hotel is fabulous and serves very delicious food. They serve authentic Kashmiri Wazwan apart from the International cuisine that they are very good at. The location and the view is breathtaking. We were fortunate to witness the season's first snowfall too. The rooms are high end, the hotel is warm. The staff are very welcoming and always there to help you.

A must visit for anyone visiting Gulmarg. We will be back for a longer duration soon!

reviews.author: Imraan S
reviews.title: Gulmarg Tour
reviews.text:
Our first ever snow experience as sunny South Africa rarely experiences snow.  Our stay at The Khyber was thoroughly enjoyable. I traveled with my wife and 5 children and we received a warm reception. The rooms were flawless and our needs were promptly attended too. The only thing that I could have picked on which wasn't a really big deal anyway was the toilet rolls which had a paper consistency. No free wifi was also a disadvantage for a foreigner as my prepaid SIM card purchased with roaming in Mumbai did not work in Gulmarg as it is a "Restricted Area" which made communication difficult. 
Special Thanks to Shyam at The Cloves and Nazia at reception for the warm hospitality. I would recommend using a Tour Guide when visiting the Gondolas as their cost for the day is 600INR. Our Guide Mama made it easier for us as he had purchased our tickets and negotiated tariffs for use of the snowmobiles and skiing. Our Driver Mushtaq 9906656151 arranged Mama for us. We used the service of Mushtaq as he operates a 4 wheel drive SUV that is capable of withstanding snow ridden roads and his tariffs are reasonable. 
Highly recommended for all South Africans to visit who want a snow resort

reviews.author: Adventure601895
reviews.title: I can never forget this place^^
reviews.text: Food was yummy! View is awesome! Cleanliness is right at the top! Service is great! I would like to give recognition to this staffs: Bilal, Sajad & Nawwaz; Thank you for making our stay memorable! Everything there is so convenient for the customers to obtain any information we want. This is the hotel that definitely most will want to return again!

reviews.author: Pooja P
reviews.title: Heaven on earth
reviews.text: The scenery was reminiscent of Narnia and the hotel a luxury spa. It was a totally different world, warm and cozy on the inside and white blanket of snow outside..the hotel is all glass, high bay windows which make you feel that the snow is just a touch away. Our room overlooked the valley and getting up in the morning to snow in the balcony rated as one of the unforgettable moments. You could look at the valley from the bath tub as well and the swimming pool is to die for! Only that swimming after this will feel boring for the rest of your life! The hotel deserves 5 stars and more for the location and amenities. Bucket list variety

reviews.author: Masood6641
reviews.title: Awesome place
reviews.text: Surely one of the best places to stay in Gulmarg,both in summers and winters..I can say one of the best luxury hotels i have stayed till now...The view from the luxury balcony rooms is breathtaking and the snow capped mountains awesome...

reviews.author: manan03
reviews.title: FIRST ANNIVERSARY
reviews.text: We stayed in Khyber for 2 nights..We had experienced both the views, himalayan as well as gulmarg view..both the views were mesmerizing..moreover gandola tickets were available at the walking distance of 5 min from the hotel..the staff was very cooperative..great hospitality shown by the staff and our special thanks to Mr. Zafar Malik for making our trip so memorable..we'll soon be planning a family trip..the warmth and hospitality shown by the staff will definitely make it to reach the greater heights..

reviews.author: Markus R
reviews.title: The best hotel you can get in Gulmarg
reviews.text: Wer nach Gulmarg geht, der weiß, auf was er sich einlässt. Das Khyber ist mit Abstand besser als alle anderen Hotels in Gulmarg, verdient im internationalen Vergleich aber die Sterne nicht wirklich. Das Essen ist gut, der Service auch und die Anlage ist auch schön. In den Details, die jedoch nach westlichen Standards Hotels dieser Klasse ausmachen, fehlt es aber. Aber wie gesagt - nachdem wir auch in anderen Hotels waren würden wir nur noch das Khyber buchen.

reviews.author: vikas1205
reviews.title: Family Vacation
reviews.text: Just perfect...right from reception to room service to restaurents to check out...love everything..location is just too perfect and view from the rooms towards the hills is mesmerizing..amazing buffet at dinner and breakfast..and not to forget the lovely Kahwa served at the time of check-in

reviews.author: RKD
reviews.title: "Best place to stay with family its real paradise on earth"
reviews.text: This property was booked by my travel agent Sandhya from "Redchilli Holidays" .. I must be thankful to her for giving our family a memorable as well as beautiful stay. Amazing staff with very polite and humble nature and plus point is awesome location of this property, And with all such nice thing when you get your food right in taste and a good spread of variety into it than it becomes for joyful ... The view from our room was fantastic the forest and hillside full of ice .. uffff.... simply great stay.

reviews.author: swetamodi
reviews.title: Paradise on Earth
reviews.text:
The best property in Gulmarg....amazing views from the Himalaya facing rooms....with a cozy balcony....
Food is excellent...breakfast is a well spread buffet....ala carte menu also is really nice...
Service is good...staff is hospitable and courteous...

though we had a bad experience while checking out...they kept calling from 10.30 to vacate room at 12...we informed them that we will do it by 1...but they kept insisting they were full and needed by 12...then we called them to check if extension was possible and they immediately said rooms are available and we can extend....then what was the hurry to vacate the room for check out? They are stuck up on checking out at 12 without any consideration...

reviews.author: Himani Aggarwal Gupta
reviews.title: Initial glitches but awesome experience.. best hotel in Gulmarg!
reviews.text:
Booking initially happened with some technical mistake where website booked 3 adults instead of 2 adults + 1 child sharing bed. Mr Irshad was super rude in telling me that website has no technical issues and nothing more he can do about my payment of Rs. 49000.
But but but, Mr Jerin Phillips who is a FOM of Khyber, immediately called me and assured me that everything wud be taken care of. He also offered us a category upgrade with some other discounts as well. 

Anyway, airport pick up was smooth and transit happened in no time. Welcome was very warm personally by Mr. Phillips and awesome kashmiri kahwah. He happily called his chef to share the recipe of kahwah which my husband requested for. No wonder kahwah was out of the world. 

Khyber rooms are very neat and clean with lot of space and beautiful sit out and view. My bad luck happened when I immediately felt dizzy and breathless and had to be bed ridden completely. Next morning at 6:45 am we requested for a doctor on duty. Immediately Dr. zareen (not sure of the name I guess) came over, did few tests and administered oxygen etc. Of course, I didn't feel better immediately but he took so much extra care to come and check twice in a day, kept tab on medicines and other issues that we felt very safe. The need of calling him didn't arise coz doctor was very proactive.This part of stay deserves special mention as I have never come across any doctor who attends to his patient proactively and who is so caring. I felt so appreciative.

Food at Khyber was good, free of those extra spices and tasty at the same time. Buffet breakfast can be improved with extra creativity and thought. Lot of room for improvement in menu options and variety.

Everything else was impeccable and proved its rating. Must stay!

reviews.author: KETAN   P
reviews.title: EXCELLENT  HOSPITALITY
reviews.text:
To stay at The Khyber ,  Gulmarg, is an excellent  experience. To be precise its an experience  of  lifetime. Its staff, right from the reception to Dinning  area, Security  personnel  all were marvellous. The kind of personal touch they give to you is just to be experienced  once in life. Mr Zaffar Malik, in particular  was absolutely  amazing. He became like a family  member in just two days. Mr. Rouf, at the  reception  Mr. Shyam, Mr Asif at the Dinning were very good at making  us feel at home. In all it was an amazing stay at The Khyber. We would definitely  recommend  and revisit it whenever  possible . 
Ketan Pathak ,  Mumbai .

reviews.author: kunalgarggalaxy
reviews.title: Anniversary
reviews.text:
Best location, best ambience, cooperative and well trained staff.
The best part of the resort is its location. I booked a normal room but when I reached there I was upgraded to a premium room due to our 1st wedding anniversary.
A large variety of delicious meals at this altitude is a wonderful thing.
Good luck and keep it up.

reviews.author: Akanksha02
reviews.title: Truly a paradise
reviews.text:
Gulmarg is insanely beautiful and to experience that one should definitely stay in this hotel in the balcony room with himalayan view.. Right from check in to the time of check out had such a memorable time.. Each and every staff member of this resort was so courteous and well mannered especially Mr Rouf at guest help desk and Mr Faizal in the managing team. Thanks for arranging the surprise for our anniversary and making it even more special. The room was very nice with an amazing view.. bathroom was also nice, neat and clean.. Buffet was not appealing but the food we had in ala carte was very tasty. coffee shop is lil overpriced.. Spa services were good and relaxing.. had an awesome time together and would definitely plan to come back with my family soon.. 
Suggestion - as prepaid connections don't work in J&K you should provide FREE Wi-Fi in the rooms

reviews.author: tinadelhi2014
reviews.title: Not good without snow
reviews.text: We booked Khyber Gulamrg based on tripadvisor reviews. The hotel is newly built but it is already showing signs of some wear and tear. The rooms are nicely done up but expensive, we almost paid 20k for a balcony room with 1 child. The food is very rich and heavy and in spite of requesting they added lods of cream and dry fruits. The service is ok but room service is slow. Basically Gulmarg is boring as there is hardly anything one can do without snow and paying so much without snow does not make sense.

reviews.author: Nihar1905
reviews.title: Magnificent Khyber
reviews.text: Nestled in the slopes of Gulmarg the khyber is one resort which offers tourists a true himalayan experience in the lap of five star luxury. From an indoor heated swimming pool to a fully functional spa the hotel offers a fully functional restaurant, coffee shop and a cigar lounge. The breakfast was an elaborate spread. The rooms are well heated and offer an excellent view of the mountains directly across. The staff at the hotel were very courteous and helpful with all our requests. A special thank you to Mr. Sujith Herbert, GM, for ensuring that our stay was comfortable. Mr Zafar, (front desk) keep that wonderful smile going!! Surely looking forward to visit the Khyber again.

reviews.author: Megsmumbai2014
reviews.title: Absolutely Amazing
reviews.text: This is one of the most spectacular and beautiful resorts in India, where modern day luxury meets colonial charm and old world hospitality. Kudos to the owners and the teams that run this property. It's truly a jewel in Kashmirs crown, making our visit to Gulmarg totally worth it and memorable. Superb views and its perfect location near the gondola, only add to the almost perfect charm to this hotel. Will surely go back some day!!

reviews.author: absibb
reviews.title: IBW conference khyber
reviews.text: Best resort i have been to excellent rooms with good view ask for rooms at upper level for good views. reception area awesome. food average. no free wifi. walk up to resort is steep eshausting. nice memories

reviews.author: SamKanwar47
reviews.title: Luxury with a view!
reviews.text: We travelled to Gulmarg in December and stayed here. The place is in the most spectacular location. I have never visited anywhere quite like this. You a surrounded by the most stunning views of the mountains - almost too picture perfect to feel real. The hotel is fantastic. Great rooms, great staff and really accommodating. The food is delicious - please try the Kashmiri Kawa there - it's perfect for the cold mountain air. A must try is the heated swimming pool which is too beautiful for words. They have ceiling to floor glass windows encasing the pool so you have stunning views while in the warm, cosy comfort of a heated pool. It hadn't started snowing while we were there, but it does around January when the gold course gets converted into the skiing area and I'm sure that will be amazing. Wish we could've stayed longer.  I would 100% recommend Khyber to anyone wishing to travel to Kashmir. It was one of the most memorable experiences for me ever!

reviews.author: shenekurien
reviews.title: Simply Aswesome
reviews.text: Went for a team meeting and the place was picture perfect. Totally awesome place, great food, great rooms and excellent staff.  Nice hotel in a very picturesque location. Truly five star in every aspect.

reviews.author: FrequentGuest555
reviews.title: Truly amazing - in all respects
reviews.text: What an incredible experience our stay at this magnificent resort was. Beautiful beyond description, with attention to detail and service to match. The GM, Mr Herbert, and his impeccable team can be proud of the standard they have set. We'll be visiting again - hopefully soon !

reviews.author: Rohitas
reviews.title: The only worthwhile place to stay in gulmarg
reviews.text: Everything is good about Khyber. The booking department is the only weak link in the whole experience. The Staff members are courteous. They have a sense of ownership. In short, it's really worth gking at least once

reviews.author: TeenaNewDelhi
reviews.title: Heaven on Earth
reviews.text:
Was lucky enough to be there during snowfalls , amazing ambience, fresh snow made fortreacherousg weather .
the whole hotel is centrally heated with a heated piil overliikung the valley a L'octain spa to sooth ur tired muscles the steep cost is worth it .
only problem is when u reach gulmarg the locales blockade, dissuade and threaten u to hire the treacherous snow sled or horses instead of reaching the resort by car .

reviews.author: Suren0005
reviews.title: Khyber Resort - Breathtaking !!!
reviews.text:
Hi Guys, I just returned from Gulmarg after staying 4 nights in Khyber, Gulmarg to celebrate my anniversary... We had planned to celebrate our day in a foreign location - but I'm so happy that we stayed in Khyber Gulmarg...

Cant wait to come back to Khyber !!!!

reviews.author: Harsh J
reviews.title: great view and good amenities
reviews.text: This is one of the hotels which i have liked and stayed there for a day though, but there were some nik naks which were to be addressed to like the in room facilities to be looked into. etc but was a great experience there. heard that sometimes there are a few lions that come but as the property is guarded it is ok.

reviews.author: sandy42900
reviews.title: Excellent property...
reviews.text:
If you reach this hotel in flat 3 hrs from from Delhi , why would you go to Switzerland/ Austria etc, yet to see a property made with so much love and maintained so well, spa is lovely fantastic pool, lovely cigar lounge , I could go on and on but thing worth mentioning is the view from the balcony rooms ( mountain side) and the service  and attitude of all staff...
   No negative....

reviews.author: PradipSKumar
reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: I stayed with my family at the Khyber Gulmarg and truly appreciate the way this hotel and its staff is. Beautiful Decor, Excellent Rooms, Spacious Bathrooms above all of this very very courteous staff and delicious food. No wonder it is one of small leading hotels they really deserves it. But only thing is the reservation staff should be more proactive in responding to phone calls and mails. Need to make too many calls and mails exchange to get the booking confirmation.

reviews.author: NBD06
reviews.title: In the snow lap of luxury
reviews.text:
A late night arrival into the gloom of the dark and the white of snow can be very intimidating. The Khyber Gulmarg instantly warmed us up to Kashmir with it's perfectly fermented cup of kahwa and an upgrade to it's luxury balcony rooms! 

The property is beautiful and the rooms luxurious but what really made us feel most pleased was the hospitality of the staff the bearers the guards and everyone else that belonged to the Khyber. 

Strongly recommend this space for a taste of luxury, snow and spa!

reviews.author: Fareed Suliman Dindar
reviews.title: Winter Wonderland
reviews.text:
Gulmarg, Kashmir and Khyber the combination in winter can only be described as a "Winter Wonderland". Outside may be a freezing sub zero temperature but one can jump into the heated pool and look out at the snow.
The service and personal attention guest receive from the GM and Preet is amazing. Our tour guide was rather late for the gondola ride up to the snow capped Himalayas, the GM at a distance noticed our irritation and immediately walked over and went out of his way to resolve our frustration by offering to provide a hotel sponsored guide so that we do not miss the gondola ride. 
The rooms are well specked and spacious with breathtaking views of the snow capped mountains. Indeed we were even upgraded at no cost.
Indian service and hospitality is par excellance.

If I were to nitpick , I missed the little slippers in my room offered by most of the 5 star establishments.

reviews.author: djlovestravel
reviews.title: Need train reservations staff better
reviews.text:
On the onset I must say that Khyber has been one of the places I have been desperately waiting to go to from the time it opened. Having found a 3 day window to do the same, I called the reservations no. that is mentioned on their website. A person called Masood spoke to me. I asked him for a 3 night package from the coming Monday onwards. He said its Rs 45,000. I asked if there has been any snow fall, he said not yet. So I asked (only once) if this is the best rate they can offer as its during weekdays & its not snowed yet (so skiing enthusiasts would be coming a bit later I presume) - his reply was a rudely stated line - "we are selling a property, not snow".
This was an extremely rude remark to hear from the representative of a SLH hotel. Asking for the best offer is a customers call; the hotel can provide the best rates they can. But in this process, basic decorum of speech & conduct should be maintained by the guest as well as the hotel's management. I would have even made a booking at the rate he had already quoted, had his reply been anything but what he said. You can just say that these are the best rates we have. 
And I must also state, that in properties like the Khyber - the natural surroundings is what people come for. You charge for the luxury & comfort you offer - which is fine - but I can get that in Wildflower Hall, Ananda or numerous other luxury hotels around India. I am not saying that your rate should be lower if it hasn't snowed - but the people selling it should remember that the guest who is coming is there as much for the nature as for the hotel. So in that regard - yes, you are selling the snow, the meadows, the fresh air - all of it! To my mind, this made his statement even more inappropriate.
I urge you to look into this as a management & training issue - please train him better is all I have to say. Don't reprimand his on basis of this, make him do better.
However, for right now - I will just stick to the Wildflower Hall or Ananda.

reviews.author: prakash b
reviews.title: If its gulmarg,it has to be khyber
reviews.text: The usp of the hotel is the view from the rooms.it can literally  take your breath away.it took  us 5 hrs to reach from srinagar airport due to some road blocks and reached dead tired and irritated but the view from the room was enough to make the trip worth even more.of course security was good house keeping and hotel staff were very friendly and the hotel had a very cosy and comfortable feel to it.food was good on expected lines but after two days stay when we moved to lalit grand at srinagar, we felt we should have booked all five days in khyber itself.the next time we are definitely  going to do that.

reviews.author: Praveen Rao
reviews.title: Great Location, Good Staff, Expensive Food!
reviews.text:
Khyber is indeed #1 place to be in when you are in Gulmarg. The location is superb, the rooms are luxurious and neat, views are fantastic. The staff is friendly and helpful. The hotel has good amenities for kids (Igloo with Xbox deployed, staff to engage kids, etc.)
The food is highly overpriced and the hotel is at such an elevation where you have to think twice before stepping out to dine out. Hence, it is highly recommended to go for a package, which bundles airport pickup and drop, two meals.

reviews.author: alientravelbug
reviews.title: Location is whoa....!! Total experience is good !!
reviews.text:
Stayed at the hotel for an annual business meet for the company i work with. Hotel location... exceptional... Hotel design .. Superb !! Room design .. Great, but ventilation seems to be an issue.. Breakfast... Grand and definitely not to be missed. Housekeeping can be expedited ... a little slow most of the times !

But definitely will recommend a stay with family and friends whenever you get a chance.

reviews.author: Noelcwt
reviews.title: Excellent 5 star hotel
reviews.text:
One of the best 5 star hotels that I've ever stayed in. The whole experience is superb and the room have a fantastic view of the mountains. We had a luxury room with a sit out balcony as a couple and I must highly recommend for couples who is looking to travel to Gulmarg. Spend a night or most two nights as there are nothing much in Gulmarg itself. I must say I enjoyed the hotel's experience more than I enjoyed Gulmarg as a whole. 

The hotel is very close to the main attraction of Gulmarg, the gondola ride. It is just 5 to 10 minutes walk away from the hotel. They have proper central heating in the hotel itself and the room. In winter the temperature could drop to minus 10 degree Celsius so proper heating is very essential. They only have one dining restaurant and the food was better than average albeit a little pricey. Room service is fast and staff are very courteous and helpful. I did not experienced its spa nor swimming pool but I think they are not operational everyday or at least that's what I found out. 

We had spaghetti as dinner and my girlfriend found it to be tasteless and the staff saw us keep adding spices and salt to the spaghetti, so he came and asked for our opinion and my girlfriend complained that the spaghetti was tasteless. To my surprise, they waived the spaghetti charges and made it complimentary for us. I must say that's very kind of them and it shows they really take customers' feedback seriously.

I would definitely recommend this hotel to others and my friends. They are not cheap, but certainly worth it.

reviews.author: merchaant
reviews.title: Experience
reviews.text: It was pleasant experience and the staff is also very helpful and cooperative ,excellent location to stay in gulmarg,but expensive but nothing to beat this place,always will be first choice to stay in gulmarg and good location from each room of mountains covered with snow and good is very good

reviews.author: Samrat
reviews.title: Good Resort
reviews.text:
We visited Gulmarg from 19th Dec for 3 nights and stayed at Khyber. The staff is cordial and the food is good... The interiors have been done well only considering the fact that it opened on 21st Dec 2012.. but the wear and tear have started... e,g the room numbers have started falling off and they have darkened them with ball point pen.. it is a good property but definately not 5* as the lifts dont work. Elderly and people with special needs will have major challenges with 4-5 levels of the hotel...e,g, IGLOO - the place where kids can play xbox360 and indoor games is 2 levels below common area..  the spa was not functional till 21st Dec and they denied taking any booking till 21st Morning.. The Spa was smelling on 21st as work was still going on.. No Sauna facility, the passage to the spa did not have centralised heating. The Swimming pool was also not functional.. 
Their website name says it is a hotel www.khyberhotels.com and they say that it is himalayan resort...Generally good resorts are theme based and there is no activites/attractions to call it a resort... So what is it still needs to be dtermined.. They have to work hard for ranking in SLH..Like any other hotel it has a snooker table, playing area for kids and igloo for indoor games.....
No iron and ironing board.. Available on request but not as they write..
They have a open area on the first floor called the NOUF where you can sit and admire natures beauty but the barbeque was not functional as there were not enough guests.... Closed as per their convenience
Also they cancelled dinner buffet as there were not enough guests.. does not happen in 5*.

An eighty room property in which is 80% occupied canceling buffet without prior notice is astonishing.

Gondola is about 5 mins walk and you get pick up & drop from/to the market but they have a challenge in answering phone calls everytime..

Overall average experience... have good views from premier mountain and balcony rooms which is an advantage.. The property is new, and the staff is cordial but is overhyped. We went to see Highland Park which has better scenic views and they have renovated this year..

reviews.author: KaustubhPS
reviews.title: Luxury in the mountains!
reviews.text:
We visited gulmarg from 12th dec to 16 Dec and stayed at Khyber . we had booked premier room with mountain view.To our delight we were upgraded to luxury room with balcony. The interiors of the room were beautifully and aesthetically done in traditional kashmiri style.View of mountain peak from the room was simply amazing.Main lobby of the hotel impressed me the most. kashmiri artifacts, photos and furniture enhanced the experience. Hotel staff service was excellent. Food was also good.we tried kashmiri dishes and loved it. Chinese menu was also good.

Only one problem was a bit slippery new wooden flooring in the room.This needs to be taken care of.

Overall I will definitely recommend Khyber for an enjoyable and luxurious experience in gulmarg.

reviews.author: bsanjay431
reviews.title: stay at Gulmarg
reviews.text:
Every thing was excellent --- Duty Manager ---Bilal Ahmad was helpful during whole stay
food was excellent--- snowfall and the view from the Hotel is mindblowing
last wk we were in the Hotel in luxuary room --- 
we love and will defenatly visit the Hotel and Gulmarg in summer again

reviews.author: SandipanChakraborty
reviews.title: Just wow
reviews.text: We recently had the privilege of staying there for three nights, and i must say its amazing. The rooms were spacious with private balcony and offers all the comfort you require in chilly winter. View from our balcony offered us magnificent views. One can easily spend the whole day by just sitting there and enjoying nature. Our primary concern was our son who is two years old but the rooms were so well equipped that he was very comfortable. I must say it's worth every penny.

reviews.author: ohshinin
reviews.title: International luxury at a national resort
reviews.text:
I had been to Khyber Himalaya resort and spa for a 3 DnN stay . The experience was wonderful. They delivered whatever was promised. Staff is trained very well and is courteous. Food is  amazing.High standards being followed.
Thanks team Khyber for making our stay a memorable one.

reviews.author: Shabnamgupta
reviews.title: Expensive for what it offers
reviews.text: We had heard great things about this new so called resort in gulmarg but we were disappointed for several reasons. Firstly they call themselves a mountain resort & spa but neither they are a resort nor they have a spa, there's not even a heated swimming pool. The hotel offers very average views of gulmarg bowl. The rooms though are nice and food is decent but overall they are too expensive for what they have to offer.

reviews.author: Navjot K
reviews.title: A honeymoon to remember :)
reviews.text:
Me and my husband started a brand new journey of our lives with the breathtaking view of the Apharwat snow capped mountains at the Khyber..the hotel is majestic and spacious, its grandeur spellbounds you the minute you enter the premises. 

The location is breathtaking esp the room in which we stayed..the infrastructure..amazing..royal..plush..we could actually see phase 2 of Apharwat mountains from the bathroom..jus sink into the giant tub and you dunt feel like letting go off your eyes from the window. The balcony was comfy. with a nice sitout arrangement, we used to love spending our mornings there.

At Khyber, the Service and hospitality depicts the pure Kashmiriyat in all the staff. They are warm, gentle, affectionate and very caring people. And of course very well and professionally trained as well. Mr. Mudasir who welcomed us into the hotel Mr. Mansoor who made sure we were treated and served best..and the General Manager. Mr. Waseem Raja..thanks to him for the VIP treatment we got at the Khyber. ..the food is great especially the breakfast buffet, it's the best breakfast i've had!  Wish there was a dinner buffet as they have an amazing variety to choose from. The room service is quick, responsible and very courteous. The first aid and medical staff is very humble and caring, the doctor personally came to check on me as I was unwell, he made sure he followed up on me from time to time.

The Gondola ride is just five minutes away..which makes your travel very easy. The upcoming pool , gym and spa are going to be a great hit! In the end, we were surprised with the sweetest souveneir (wooden carved Khyber photoframe with our pic) from the staff that really made our day and made us feel very special. Our best wishes are with the Khyber and we will surely be looking forward to visiting them again soon!

reviews.author: Karun A
reviews.title: World class luxury in Gulmarg
reviews.text:
This was a family holiday to Kashmir and my parents decided to book us into The Khyber Kimalayan Resort & Spa for our 3 night stay in Gulmarg after spending 2 nights in Srinagar and 3 nights in Pahalgam. I can honestly say we saved the best for last!

The Khyber was an amazingly refreshing experience from the very moment the car we were in approached the property. What was truly remarkable was the prime location and the amazing design aesthetic that is woven into every fibre of the 7 acre property. From the cobblestones in the drive way to the balanced wood and stone construction of the entire property and the grand chandelier and breathtaking views all around, that greet visitors upon arrival, you instantly feel you have arrived at a resort that would rival any of the worlds finest in more traditional but just as exotic resorts around the world from Aspen, Colorado, USA or Chamonix - Mont Blanc, France or Vermatt, Switzerland or Whistler, BC. This in itself, I think is some feat. Although a tremendous amount of credit for this goes to the surreal beauty of Gulmarg and Kashmir!

Everything about this resort makes it world class and you feel that as soon as you walk into a grand space where you are greeted by one of the managers personally who checks you in before showing you to the rooms. But first a warm cup of traditional 'Kawa' tea awaits to refresh and a warm or cold towel depending I imagine on what time of the year you arrive as a guest. 

We were surprised to learn that our rooms had been upgraded from Premier Mountain View Rooms to Luxury Balcony Rooms (albeit not with Mountain View). This in itself was a blessing as the Mountain View rooms get more direct sunlight and make it less easier to to actually sit in the balcony outside and enjoy the views with blinding sun in your eyes. Although in winter with the snow around, this may not be such a bad thing. In any case, the rooms themselves were spacious and truly luxurious with teakwood floors and walnut furniture complementing the heavily embroidered, rich darker shades of gold and maroon. Flatscreen TVs, a plush bed with amazing pillows and a wardrobe made the basic amenities excellent. And then you entered what has got to be one of the best designed and luxurious bathrooms around with a massive sunken tub with floor to ceiling windows looking out at the surrounding valleys - can't think of a better way to wash your troubles away and soak in the breathtaking views.

The locally spun carpets that adorn the rooms and bathrooms are very tasteful as well. Unfortunately the hotel was out of stock for the particular design we wanted to purchase which was unfortunate. 

The staff at the hotel were mostly excellent. Barring the gentleman who checked us in, whose name I can't remember, which says a lot for his quality. The one member of staff that truly made our stay exceptional was Mr Shyam - the F&B Manger/ Executive. For every meal at the hotel, which was fantastic (massive respect to the Chefs and team in the kitchen) across a variety of cuisines, Shyam went above and beyond his duties to ensure we only had the best at all times and were not just satisfied but were overwhelmed by his generosity and hospitality. The food itself, from a scrumptious breakfast buffet, to stupendous Chinese food (we had three meals of Chinese during our stay) and a plethora of cheese and dessert options, was exceptional and complemented by impeccable service. 

Unfortunately a few of the 'extras' at the resort including the pool, Spa and the outdoor grill/ barbecue area weren't yet operational when we went. But i can only imagine how much more these would add to the experience, especially in winter once they are. 

The views from the hotel itself are just stunning - with snow capped peaks and pine forests all around. The hotel also, is a 5 min walk to the Gondola which takes you up to the world's highest ski point. 

I can honestly say that the experience at Khyber can almost be an excuse to go to Kashmir if not for the beauty of this amazing state itself.

reviews.author: Amit T
reviews.title: Surprised beyond expectation!
reviews.text:
We selected the hotel after having read the reviews on tripadvisor. Being our first trip to Kashmir, we were skeptical of our decision before reaching the hotel. 

But, all our doubts took a dive just as we reached the hotel entrance. The magnificence of the property spread across the beautiful landscape, surrounded by pine trees and snow capped mountains was awe-inspiring. 

As soon as we entered the reception, we were greeted by Mr. Maroof. I must mention he is a very fine gentlemen. After welcoming us, he insisted that I let him carry my laptop and then he escorted us to Chaikash (tea lounge). He offered us Kava (very rejuvinating) after which we did the check-in formalities. He made sure that we got comfortable, even before we checked-in to the hotel. 

After check-in he explained to us in detail the various facilities available at the hotel, escorted us to our room and further explained all available features in the room. The icing on the cake was we were upgraded from a premium to a luxury room, that too with one of the best views of the landscape (at the center of the property).

One very rare quality that Mr. Maroof displayed was his communication skills. Whenever interrupted by us he would stop talking immediately and listen very patiently to us. And only continue once we stopped.

We stayed there for 3 nights 2 days. The hotel is just 5 minutes walk to the Gondola, which is great, no need to hire a taxi or ponies to reach the gondola. The room was very comfortable with king size beds and very comfortable pillows, mattresses etc. Nothing less than a 5-star property.

I am surprised at many reviews with negative comments for their food. I must mention we had at least 4 meals (vegetarian) at the hotel (apart from breakfast) and the food was definitely very good. And I am surprised to read about the negative comments. They have a varied selection of cuisine on their menu, including Chinese, Italian and North Indian. Although the options for vegetarians was limited to few items, the food was very good. A must try is thier Mezze Platter (falafel with pita, tatzaki, hummous etc). I was absolutely delighted with the flavours of Arabia in midst of Kashmir!!

Even the vegetarian wrap is worth a try. One wrap is quite filling for 2 people, after you have had soup. The servings portions are decent size; one portion is good for 3-4 people.

The chaikash (tea lounge) has over 25 varieties of tea, while the Kava is complimentary. 

Another gesture by the hotel was a complimentary car, on one of the nights when we wanted to go out at eat. Just for a change, we had dinner at a nearby Bakshi restaurant. The food was decent. Although it was 75% cheaper than Khyber, it would be injustice to compare it to Khyber. If anything negative about the food at khyber, then its the price. Although expensive, it is definitely worth the price. You get what you pay for.

Another gesture worth mentioning is that, we got a call from the manager at Cloves (the restaurant at Khyber), on the morning we were checking out. We were late for breakfast so he called us to ensure that we would not miss the breakfast. I don't think you would get such personal care at a 5 or 7-star property.

I did not want to leave and had to force myself to leave the care & comfort of the hotel located at one of the best landscapes in the world. I will definitely be back at Khyber.

reviews.author: Sujit B
reviews.title: Landmark property in Kashmir
reviews.text:
I was the first guest to check-in when the hotel opened and I half expected everything to fall apart as most hotels do on the day of opening. I was pleasantly surprised to find that despite all odds (they were snowed in) - they had their act together. The best parts first: It is built on traditional Kashmiri style - lots of wood and more wood; local carpets and decor. Brownie point for keeping the tradition alive. They had more than 80% locals as their staff; again a brownie point for giving an opportunity to the local youth. They had still not been fully trained and they bumbled around a bit and this is exactly what was endearing - genuine people in a hotel not acting like hoteliers! Food was very good; the rooms was excellent and the view was to die for.

Here are few thing that they need to watch out for: 1. Remove art pieces from the lobby - they make it look like a local shop. 2. Add more lights in the lobby. Ensure staff wearing clean dress and shoes AND clean socks that don't smell. Remove the small carpets placed under the table in the room - they can trip and cause someone serious harm (they slip on the polished floor). 3. Keep people to constantly clean the wooden stairs. Inspect each rooms for small flaws (the shower plate in my rooms was skewed).

But go - stay there even if for one night (they are priced steep) and you wont regret it!
